names.ar: الِاسْتِطَابَةُ بِالْمَاءِ

names.ar: دَلْكُ الْيَدِ بِالْأَرْضِ بَعْدَ الِاسْتِنْجَاءِ
names.en: Wiping the hand on the ground after using the bathroom

names.ar: ذِكْرُ مَا يُنَجِّسُ الْمَاءَ، وَمَا لَا يُنَجِّسُهُ
names.en: Mentioning what contaminates water and what doesn't contaminate it.

names.ar: التَّوْقِيتُ فِي الْمَاءِ

names.ar: تَرْكُ التَّوْقِيتِ فِي الْمَاءِ
names.en: Abandonment of Timing in Water

names.ar: الْمَاءُ الدَّائِمُ
names.en: The eternal water

names.ar: ذِكْرُ مَاءِ الْبَحْرِ وَالْوُضُوءِ مِنْهُ
names.en: The mention of seawater and performing ablution with it

names.ar: مَاءُ الثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
names.en: The water of snow and hail.

names.ar: الْوُضُوءَ بِالثَّلْجِ وَالْبَرَدِ
names.en: Performing ablution with snow and hail.

names.ar: سُؤْرُ الْحَائِضِ
names.en: The secretions of menstruation

names.ar: سُؤْرُ الْهِرِّ
names.en: The walls of the cat

names.ar: سُؤْرُ الْحِمَارِ
names.en: The male donkey's tail.

names.ar: سُؤْرُ الْكَلْبِ وَإِرَاقَةُ مَا فِي الْإِنَاءِ الَّذِي يَلِغُ فِيهِ
names.en: The heading translates to: "Filling the dog's bowl and pouring what is in the container that it lies in.

names.ar: غَسْلُ الْإِنَاءِ مِنْ وُلُوغِ الْكَلْبِ سَبْعًا
names.en: Washing the vessel from the impurities of the dog seven times

names.ar: تَعْفِيرُ الْإِنَاءِ الَّذِي يَلْغُ فِيهِ الْكَلْبُ بِالتُّرَابِ بَعْدَ غَسْلِهِ سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ
names.en: The Disinfection of the Container in Which the Dog Licks with Soil After Washing It Seven Times

names.ar: الْمَاءُ الْمُسْتَعْمَلُ
names.en: The Used Water

names.ar: وُضُوءُ الرِّجَالِ وَالنِّسَاءِ جَمِيعًا
names.en: The ablution of men and women all.

names.ar: الطَّهَارَةُ بِفَضْلِ الْجُنُبِ
names.en: The purity due to janabah.

names.ar: الْقَدْرُ الَّذِي يَكْتَفِي بِهِ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ لِلْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The amount of water sufficient for a person to perform ablution.

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ مِنَ الْإِنَاءِ وَالْوُضُوءُ فِي الطَّسْتِ
names.en: Wudu from a vessel and wudu in the container

names.ar: النِّيَّةُ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The Intention in Wudu

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The virtue of ablution

names.ar: كَيْفَ يُدْعَى إِلَى الطَّهُورِ
names.en: How is one invited to purification?

names.ar: صَبُّ الْخَادِمِ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ الْمَاءَ لِلْوُضُوءِ
names.en: Pouring water for a man's ablution

names.ar: الْقُعُودُ عَلَى الْكُرْسِيِّ لِلْوُضُوءِ
names.en: Sitting on the chair for ablution

names.ar: التَّسْمِيَةُ عِنْدَ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The Name When Performing Wudu

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ مَرَّةً، مَرَّةً
names.en: Wudu once, once

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ مَرَّتَيْنِ مَرَّتَيْنِ وَثَلَاثًا
names.en: Performing Wudu Twice or Thrice

names.ar: كَيْفَ يَغْسِلُ كَفَّيْهِ
names.en: How does he wash his hands?

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ ثَلَاثًا ثَلَاثًا
names.en: Wudu is performed three times, three times.

names.ar: الِاعْتِدَاءُ فِي الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: Attack in ablution.

names.ar: غَسْلُ الْكَفَّيْنِ قَبْلَ الْوُضُوءِ وَالْمَضْمَضَةُ وَالِاسْتِنْشَاقُ بِالْيُمْنَى مِنْهُمَا
names.en: Washing the hands before ablution, gargling, and inhaling from the right

names.ar: الْمَضْمَضَةُ وَالِاسْتِنْشَاقُ بِكَفٍّ وَاحِدَةٍ
names.en: Mouthwash and Nasal Irrigation in one palm

names.ar: الِاسْتِنْثَارُ بِالْيُسْرَى
names.en: Scattering with the left

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالِاسْتِنْثَارِ
names.en: The command to disperse.

names.ar: بِكَمْ يَسْتَنْثِرُ
names.en: How much does he squander?

names.ar: إِيجَابُ الِاسْتِنْشَاقِ
names.en: The Beneficial Inhalation

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْمُبَالَغَةِ فِي الِاسْتِنْشَاقِ لِغَيْرِ الصَّائِمِ
names.en: Command to exaggerate while inhaling for non-fasting individuals

names.ar: بِكَمْ يَتَمَضْمَضُ وَيَسْتَنْشِقُ
names.en: How much time does it take to rinse and inhale?

names.ar: صِفَةُ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: Description of ablution

names.ar: عَدَدُ مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ وَكَيْفِيَّتِهِ
names.en: The number of head scans and their methodology

names.ar: كَيْفَ تَمْسَحُ الْمَرْأَةُ رَأْسَهَا
names.en: How does a woman wipe her head?

names.ar: مَسْحُ الْأُذُنَيْنِ مَعَ الرَّأْسِ وَذِكْرُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى أَنَّهُمَا مِنَ الرَّأْسِ
names.en: Cleaning the ears along with the head and mentioning what can be inferred from it as being part of the head

names.ar: الْمَسْحُ عَلَى الْعِمَامَةِ مَعَ النَّاصِيَةِ
names.en: Wiping on the Turban with the Naqib

names.ar: صِفَةُ الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْعِمَامَةُ
names.en: The Description of Cleaning on the Turban

names.ar: إِيجَابُ غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ
names.en: The benefits of washing the two feet.

names.ar: غَسْلُ الرِّجْلَيْنِ بِالْيَدَيْنِ
names.en: Washing the feet with the hands

names.ar: بِأَيِّ الرِّجْلَيْنِ يَبْدَأُ فِي الْغَسْلِ
names.en: Which of the two feet should one start with during washing?

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِتَخْلِيلِ الْأَصَابِعِ
names.en: The command to interlace the fingers

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ فِي النِّعَالِ السِّبْتِيَّةِ
names.en: Wudu in Saturday's sandals

names.ar: الْمَسْحُ عَلَى الرِّجْلَيْنِ
names.en: Wiping on the feet

names.ar: الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ
names.en: Wiping or rubbing on the socks

names.ar: الْمَسْحُ عَلَى الْجَوْرَبَيْنِ وَالنَّعْلَيْنِ
names.en: The wiping on the socks and the two slippers

names.ar: التَّوْقِيتُ فِي الْمَسْحِ عَلَى الْخُفَّيْنِ لِلْمُقِيمِ وَالْمُسَافِرِ
names.en: Timing in wiping over the socks for the resident and the traveler.

names.ar: صِفَةُ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَدَثٍ
names.en: The Description of Wudu without Impurity

names.ar: الْوُضُوءُ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
names.en: Wudu for every prayer

names.ar: النَّضْحُ
names.en: Al-Nadhu

names.ar: الِانْتِفَاعُ بِفَضْلِ الْوَضُوءِ
names.en: The benefits of ablution

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِإِسْبَاغِ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: Command to perform ablution

names.ar: الْفَضْلُ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The virtue in that

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ كَمَا أُمِرَ
names.en: The reward of the one who performs ablution as instructed.

names.ar: الْقَوْلُ بَعْدَ الْفَرَاغِ مِنَ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The statement after completing ablution

names.ar: حِلْيَةُ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The Adornment of Ritual Ablution

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوَضُوءِ مِنَ الْغَائِطِ وَالْبَوْلِ
names.en: The command of performing ablution after defecation and urination.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالتْوُضُؤِ مِنَ الْمَذْيِ
names.en: The command to perform ablution from impurity.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوَضُوءِ مِنَ الرِّيحِ
names.en: The command to make ablution from wind.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوُضُوءِ لِلْنَائِمِ الْمُضْطَجِعِ
names.en: The command for performing wudu for the lying down sleeper

names.ar: النُّعَاسُ
names.en: The drowsiness

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْوُضُوءِ مِنَ الْقُبْلَةَ
names.en: Leaving Wudu from the Qibla.

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ مَسِّ الرَّجُلِ امْرَأَتَهُ لِغَيْرِ شَهْوَةٍ
names.en: Leaving ablution from touching one's wife without desire

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوَضُوءِ مِنْ مَسِّ الرَّجُلِ ذَكَرَهُ
names.en: Ordering a man to perform ablution when touching his penis

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي تَرْكِ الْوُضُوءِ مِنْ مَسِّ الذَّكَرِ
names.en: The license to leave ablution from touching the male organ.

names.ar: الِاقْتِصَارُ عَلَى غَسْلِ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ فِي الْوُضُوءِ بَعْدَ غَسْلِ الْوَجْهِ دُونَ الْيَدَيْنِ وَذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِلْخَبَرِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: Restricting to washing the arms in ablution after washing the face, excluding the hands, and mentioning the disagreement of the narrators regarding this matter.

names.ar: عَدَدُ غَسْلِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ
names.en: The number of washing feet

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَلْفَاظِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ الْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ فِيهِ
names.en: Mentioning the difference in wording among the narrators regarding the news of Al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah in it.

names.ar: عَدَدُ مَسْحِ الرَّأْسِ وَذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافُ النَّاقِلِينَ لِلْخَبَرِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The number of head scans and the mention of the variation of reporters in that

names.ar: فَرْضُ الْوُضُوءِ
names.en: The obligation of ablution.

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ فَأَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ
names.en: The reward of those who perform ablution and perfect their ritual purification

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ تَوَضَّأَ ثُمَّ أَتَى الْمَسْجِدَ فَرَكَعَ فِيهِ رَكْعَتَيْنِ
names.en: The reward for one who performs ablution then comes to the mosque and prays two units of prayer in it

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ أَحْسَنَ الْوُضُوءَ ثُمَّ صَلَّى رَكْعَتَيْنِ
names.en: Reward for those who perform the best ablution and then offer two units of prayer

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوَضُوءِ مِمَّا مَسَّتِ النَّارُ
names.en: The command for ablution from what the fire has touched.

names.ar: نَسْخُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: Copying that

names.ar: الْمَضْمَضَةُ مِنَ السَّوِيقِ
names.en: Mouthwash from Swieq.

names.ar: الْمَضْمَضَةُ مِنَ اللَّبَنِ
names.en: The mouthwash of milk.

names.ar: غُسْلِ الْكَافِرِ إِذَا أَسْلِمْ
names.en: Washing the disbeliever when he/she converts to Islam

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْغُسْلِ مِنْ مُوَارَاةِ الْمُشْرِكِ
names.en: The command to perform ritual washing after coming into contact with a polytheist

names.ar: وُجُوبُ الْغُسْلِ إِذَا الْتَقَى الْخِتَانَانِ
names.en: The necessity for washing if the circumcision wounds meet

names.ar: وُجُوبُ الْغُسْلِ مِنَ الْمَنِيِّ
names.en: The obligation of washing from semen

names.ar: إِيجَابُ الْغُسْلِ عَلَى الْمَرْأَةِ إِذَا احْتَلَمَتْ وَرَأَتِ الْمَاءَ
names.en: The positive aspects of washing for a woman when she has a wet dream and sees water.

names.ar: فِي الَّذِي يَحْتَلِمُ وَلَا يَرَى الْمَاءَ
names.en: Into the one who stumbles but does not see the water

names.ar: الْفَصْلُ بَيْنَ مَاءِ الرَّجُلِ وَمَاءِ الْمَرْأَةِ
names.en: Differentiating Between Male and Female Water

names.ar: الِاغْتِسَالُ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ وَالِاسْتِحَاضَةِ
names.en: The purification from menstruation and postpartum bleeding

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الْأَقْرَاءِ
names.en: The mention/recitation of the Aqra'.

names.ar: الْفَصْلُ بَيْنَ دَمِ الْحَيْضِ، وَالِاسْتِحَاضَةِ
names.en: The distinction between menstrual blood and istihadah.

names.ar: الْغُسْلِ مِنَ النِّفَاسِ
names.en: Postnatal washing

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْبَوْلِ فِي الْمَاءِ الرَّاكِدِ وَالِاغْتِسَالِ مِنْهُ
names.en: Prohibition of urinating in stagnant water and bathing from it

names.ar: الِاغْتِسَالُ بِاللَّيْلِ
names.en: Nighttime Washing

names.ar: الِاسْتِتَارُ عِنْدَ الِاغْتِسَالِ
names.en: Covering when showering

names.ar: الْقَدْرُ الَّذِي يَكْتَفِي بِهِ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الْمَاءِ لِلْغُسْلِ
names.en: The amount of water needed by a person for ablution.

names.ar: اغْتِسَالُ الرَّجُلِ وَالْمَرْأَةِ مِنْ نِسَائِهِ مِنَ الْإِنَاءِ الْوَاحِدِ
names.en: The washing of men and women from their private utensil

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الِاغْتِسَالِ بِفَضْلِ الْجُنُبِ
names.en: The prohibition of not showering due to being in a state of major ritual impurity.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The license in that

names.ar: الِاغْتِسَالُ فِي الْقَصْعَةِ الَّتِي يُعْجَنُ فِيهَا
names.en: Washing in the basin where the dough is kneaded.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي تَرْكِ الْمَرْأَةِ نَقْضَ ضَفْرِ رَأْسِهَا عِنْدَ اغْتِسَالِهَا مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ
names.en: The license to break a woman's nail when washing her from impurity.

names.ar: إِزَالَةُ الْجُنُبِ الْأَذَى عَنْ جَسَدِهِ بَعْدَ غَسْلِهِ يَدَيْهِ ثَلَاثًا
names.en: Removing impurities from his body after washing his hands three times

names.ar: صِفَةُ الْغُسْلِ مِنَ الْجَنَابَةِ
names.en: The Description of Ghusl from Janabah

names.ar: الْعَمَلُ فِي الْغُسْلِ مِنَ الْحَيْضِ
names.en: Working During Menstruation

names.ar: تَرَكَ الْوُضُوءِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ
names.en: Leaving ablution after washing

names.ar: تَرْكُ التَّمَنْدُلِ بَعْدَ الْغُسْلِ
names.en: Leaving Drips After Washing

names.ar: وَضُوءُ الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ
names.en: The ablution of the one in a state of major ritual impurity when he intends to eat

names.ar: اقْتِصَارُ الْجُنُبِ عَلَى غَسْلِ يَدَيْهِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ أَوْ يَشْرَبَ
names.en: The limitation of washing hands of the south when he wants to eat or drink.

names.ar: وُضُوءُ الْجُنُبِ وَغَسْلُهُ ذَكَرَهُ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَنَامَ
names.en: The purification of intercourse and its washing, mentioned when one wants to sleep.

names.ar: الْجُنُبُ إِذَا لَمْ يَتَوَضَّأْ
names.en: The heading translates to: "What happens if one does not perform ablution?

names.ar: فِي الْجُنُبِ إِذَا أَرَادَ أَنْ يَعُودَ
names.en: In the south, when he wants to return

names.ar: إِتْيَانُ النِّسَاءِ قَبْلَ إِحْدَاثِ غُسْلٍ
names.en: The arrival of women before performing ablution

names.ar: حَجْبُ الْجُنُبِ مِنْ قِرَاءَةِ الْقُرْآنِ
names.en: The prohibition of the junub from reading the Quran.

names.ar: مُجَالَسَةُ الْجُنُبِ وَمُمَاسَّتِهِ
names.en: The heading translates to: "Socializing and physical contact

names.ar: اسْتِخْدَامُ الْحَائِضِ
names.en: The use of sanitary pads

names.ar: بَسْطُ الْحَائِضِ الْخُمْرَةَ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The spreading of alcohol in the mosque

names.ar: فِي الرَّجُلِ يُقْرَأُ الْقُرْآنَ وَرَأْسُهُ فِي حِجْرِ امْرَأَتِهِ وَهِيَ حَائِضٌ
names.en: In English, the heading translates to: "The man reads the Quran and his wife's menstruating.

names.ar: غَسْلُ الْحَائِضِ رَأْسَ زَوْجِهَا
names.en: Washing the head of one's wife during menstruation

names.ar: فِي الْحَائِضِ تُرَجِّلُ رَأْسَ زَوْجِهَا
names.en: In menstruation, she makes her husband's head move.

names.ar: مُؤَاكَلَةُ الْحَائِضِ وَالشُّرْبُ مِنْ سُؤْرِهَا وَالِانْتِفَاعُ بِفَضْلِهَا
names.en: Intimacy during menstruation and drinking from its waters and benefiting from its blessings.

names.ar: مُضَاجَعَةُ الْحَائِضِ
names.en: Intercourse during menstruation

names.ar: مُبَاشَرَةُ الْحَائِضِ
names.en: Onset of menstruation

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ الْإِزَارِ
names.en: The position of the belt

names.ar: تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ اللهِ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {وَيَسْئَلُونَكَ عَنِ الْمَحِيضِ قُلْ هُوَ أَذًى فَاعْتَزِلُوا النِّسَاءَ فِي الْمَحِيضِ}
names.en: Interpretation of the Saying of Allah, may He be glorified and exalted, {And they ask you about menstruation. Say, It is harmful, so keep away from wives during menstruation}

names.ar: مَا يَجِبُ عَلَى مَنْ أَتَى امْرَأَتَهُ فِي حَالِ حَيْضَتِهَا مَعَ عِلْمِهِ بِنَهْيِ اللهِ ﷻ عَنْ وَطْئِهَا
names.en: What a person should do if he approaches his wife during her menstrual period, with his knowledge of Allah's prohibition from having sexual intercourse with her.

names.ar: مَا تَفْعَلُ الْمُحْرِمَةُ إِذَا حَاضَتْ
names.en: What do women do when they menstruate?

names.ar: مَا تَفْعَلُ النُّفَسَاءُ عِنْدَ الْإِحْرَامِ
names.en: What do women do during ihram?

names.ar: فِي دَمِ الْحَيْضِ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: In menstrual blood, the garment gets stained.

names.ar: الْمَنِيُّ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: Semen stains the garment.

names.ar: غَسْلُ الْمَنِيِّ مِنَ الثَّوْبِ
names.en: Washing semen off clothes

names.ar: فَرْكُ الْمَنِيِّ مِنَ الثَّوْبِ
names.en: Cleaning semen from clothing

names.ar: بَوْلُ الصَّبِيِّ الَّذِي لَمْ يَأْكُلِ الطَّعَامَ وَيُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: The subtitle: "The urine of a baby who hasn't eaten food and it stains the garment.

names.ar: الْفَصْلُ بَيْنَ الذِّكْرِ وَالْأُنْثَى
names.en: The distinction between male and female.

names.ar: بَوْلُ مَا يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: The urine of an animal whose meat is consumed stains the cloth.

names.ar: فَرْثُ مَا يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: The translation of the heading "فَرْثُ مَا يُؤْكَلُ لَحْمُهُ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ" into English is "The excrement that is produced after eating its meat stains the garment.

names.ar: الْبُصَاقُ يُصِيبُ الثَّوْبَ
names.en: Saliva stains the garment.

names.ar: بَدْءُ التَّيَمُّمِ
names.en: The beginning of Tayammum

names.ar: التَّيَمُّمُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ عَلَى عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ فِي كَيْفِيَّتِهِ
names.en: Tayammum during travel and mentioning the differences regarding Ammar ibn Yasir in its implementation.

names.ar: كَيْفَ التَّيَمُّمُ؟
names.en: How to perform Tayammum?

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ
names.en: Another Type

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ
names.en: Another type

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ
names.en: Another type

names.ar: التَّيَمُّمُ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: Tayammum in urban areas

names.ar: تَيَمُّمُ الْجُنُبِ
names.en: Tayammum al-junub

names.ar: التَّيَمُّمُ بِالصَّعِيدِ
names.en: Tayammum with sand

names.ar: الصَّلَوَاتُ بِتَيَمُّمٍ وَاحِدٍ
names.en: Prayers with a Single Tayammum

names.ar: فِيمَنْ لَا يَجِدُ الْمَاءَ وَلَا الصَّعِيدَ
names.en: For those who cannot find water or a desert

names.ar: كِتَابُ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Ṣalāh (Prayer)

names.ar: فَرْضُ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The obligation of prayer

names.ar: أَيْنَ فُرِضَتِ الصَّلَوَاتُ
names.en: Where were the prayers prescribed?

names.ar: كَيْفَ فُرِضَتِ الصَّلَاةُ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: How was prayer established and the mention of differences in that

names.ar: كَمْ فُرِضَتِ الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْيَوْمِ وَاللَّيْلَةِ؟
names.en: How many times is prayer obligated during the day and night?

names.ar: الْبِيعَةُ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ
names.en: The sale of the five prayers

names.ar: الْمُحَافَظَةُ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ
names.en: Maintaining the Five Prayers

names.ar: فَضْلُ الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ
names.en: The excellence of the five daily prayers

names.ar: قَوْلُهُ «أَقِيمُوا الصَّلَاةَ»
names.en: His saying "Establish the prayer

names.ar: الْمُحَاسَبَةُ عَلَى تَرَكِ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Accounting for neglecting prayer

names.ar: تَكْفِيرُ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The exclusion of prayer

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ أَقَامَ الصَّلَاةَ
names.en: The reward for those who establish the prayer.

names.ar: الْحُكْمُ فِي تَارِكِ الصَّلَاةِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The ruling on abandoning prayer and mentioning the differences regarding it.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَعْدَ الزَّوَالِ
names.en: Praying after midday

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ الظُّهْرِ وَذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَلْفَاظِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِلْخَبَرِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The number of prayers before noon and the mention of the variation in the wording of the narrators of the news in that.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَلْفَاظِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ، عَنْ عَاصِمِ بْنِ ضَمْرَةَ، عَنْ عَلِيٍّ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The mention of the differing wording of the narrators of the news of Abu Ishaq, from Aasim ibn Damrah, from Ali in that

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: The number of Dhuhr prayers in the city.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The number of Dhuhr prayers during travel.

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ
names.en: The number of prayers after noon.

names.ar: بَابُ الصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: Praying before Asr.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الظُّهْرِ وَقَبْلَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The mention of differences in prayer after noon and before afternoon.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: The number of Asr prayers in urban areas.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The number of Asr prayers during travel.

names.ar: فَضْلُ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The virtue of the Asr prayer

names.ar: تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ اللهِ عَزَّ جَلَّ: {حَافِظُوا عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى} [البقرة: 238] وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى
names.en: Interpretation of the saying of Allah Almighty: {Guard strictly the prayers, especially the middle prayer} [Surah Al-Baqarah: 238] and mentioning the differences in the middle prayer.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ زَيْدِ بْنِ ثَابِتٍ فِي صَلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى
names.en: The mention of the carriers' disagreement regarding Zaid ibn Thabit's news in the middle prayer

names.ar: تَرْكُ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: Leaving the prayer of al-Asr.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْمُحَافَظَةِ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْوُسْطَى وَصَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The order to maintain the prayers, the middle prayer, and the afternoon prayer

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: License in the two prostrations after Asr

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The prohibition of praying after Asr.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ إِذَا كَانَتِ الشَّمْسُ بَيْضَاءَ مُرْتَفِعَةً
names.en: The license in prayer after Asr, if the sun is bright and high.

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: The number of prayers before the Maghrib prayer

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَعْدَ أَذَانِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: Prayer after the call to Maghrib prayer

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: The number of Maghrib prayers.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: Prayer after Maghrib

names.ar: كَيْفَ الرَّكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ الْمَغْرِبِ؟ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: How are the two Sunnah units of prayer after Maghrib? And mention the differences in that.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ وَالْعِشَاءِ
names.en: Prayer between Maghrib and Isha

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: The Number of Isha Prayers in Urban Areas

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الْعِشَاءِ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: Praying Isha prayer while traveling

names.ar: فَضْلُ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ
names.en: The Excellence of the Late Night Prayer

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِيهِ
names.en: Prayer after Isha and mention of the differences in it

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
names.en: The number of prayers after the last Isha prayer in the month of Ramadan

names.ar: كَيْفَ الصَّلَاةُ فِي شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ
names.en: How is prayer in the month of Ramadan?

names.ar: ذَكَرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي كَيْفِيَّةِ صَلَاةِ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ بِاللَّيْلِ
names.en: The Differences among the Narrators regarding the News of Abdullah ibn Abbas on the Method of the Prophet's ﷺ Night Prayer.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَبِي إِسْحَاقَ وَسَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ عَنْ أَبِي سَلَمَةَ بْنِ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ فِيهِ
names.en: Discussion of the disagreement between Abu Ishaq and Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id about Abu Salamah ibn 'Abdul Rahman

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافُ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ عَائِشَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The Mention of the Disagreement of Reporters about Aisha's Story in That

names.ar: عَدَدُ الْوِتْرِ
names.en: The number of odd.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالْوِتْرِ
names.en: The command of oddness

names.ar: كَمِ الْوِتْرُ
names.en: How much is the odd number?

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْوِتْرُ بِرَكْعَةٍ وَاحِدَةٍ
names.en: How to perform Witr prayer in one unit

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْوِتْرُ بِثَلَاثٍ
names.en: How is Witr (prayer) performed in three (units)?

names.ar: الْوِتْرُ بِتِسْعِ
names.en: The odd number with nine

names.ar: الْوِتْرُ بِسَبْعٍ
names.en: Al-Witr with Seven

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَيْنَ الْوِتْرِ وَبَيْنَ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِيهِ
names.en: Prayer between Witr and the two Rak'ah of Fajr and mentioning the discrepancy in it.

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: Order of Offering Two Rakahs Before Fajr Prayer

names.ar: الْمُعَاهَدَةُ عَلَى الرَّكْعَتَيْنِ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: The treaty on the two units before the dawn prayer.

names.ar: فَضْلُ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: The Virtue of the Two Sunnah Units of the Morning Prayer

names.ar: فَضْلُ صَلَاةِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: The virtue of the dawn prayer

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: The number of Fajr prayers

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ
names.en: Prohibition of praying after dawn until the sunrise

names.ar: الْحَثُّ عَلَى صَلَاةِ أَوَّلِ النَّهَارِ
names.en: Encouragement to perform the morning prayer

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الضُّحَى
names.en: The translation of the heading "صَلَاةُ الضُّحَى" into English is "The Duha Prayer".

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ عِنْدَ زَوَالِ الشَّمْسِ مِنْ مَطْلِعِهَا كَقَدْرِ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ مِنْ مَغْرِبِهَا
names.en: Translation: Prayer at sunset is equivalent to the prayer of Asr from its beginning to its end.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ إِذَا ارْتَفَعَ الضُّحَى
names.en: Prayer when the sun rises

names.ar: كَمْ صَلَاةُ النَّهَارِ
names.en: How many prayers are there during the day?

names.ar: الْحَثُّ عَلَى رَكْعَتَيِ الضُّحَى
names.en: Encouragement to perform the two units of Duha prayer

names.ar: التَّسْهِيلُ فِي تَرْكِهَا
names.en: Facilitating in its abandonment

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الضُّحَى فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: The number of Duha prayer in the city.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الضُّحَى فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The number of Duha prayer while traveling.

names.ar: كَيْفَ صَلَاةُ الضُّحَى
names.en: How to perform the Duha prayer

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ حَافِظَ عَلَى ثِنْتَيْ عَشْرَةَ رَكْعَةٍ فِي كُلِّ يَوْمٍ
names.en: The reward for someone who preserves twelve units of prayer each day

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْفِطْرِ وَصَلَاةِ النَّحْرِ
names.en: The Number of Eid al-Fitr Prayer and Eid al-Adha Prayer

names.ar: تَرْكُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الْفِطْرِ وَالنَّحْرِ
names.en: Leaving prayers after the prayers of Eid al-Fitr and Eid al-Adha

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ قَبْلَ الْخُطْبَةِ
names.en: Prayer before the sermon.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The number of Friday prayers

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The Number of Prayers After Friday Prayer and Mentioning the Differences in That.

names.ar: أَيْنَ تُصَلَّى الرَّكْعَتَانِ بَعْدَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Where are the two units of prayer offered after Friday prayer?

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الِاسْتِسْقَاءِ
names.en: The number of prayers for seeking rain

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةُ الْكُسُوفِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The number of the eclipse prayers and mentioning the differences in that.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ عَلَى عَائِشَةَ فِي عَدَدِ صَلَاةِ الْخُسُوفِ
names.en: The Mention of the Differences Regarding Aisha in the Number of Eclipse Prayers.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ عَلَى ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فِي عَدَدِ صَلَاةِ الْكُسُوفِ
names.en: The dispute regarding Ibn Abbas's difference in the number of eclipse prayers.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْمُسَافِرِ
names.en: The number of prayers for travelers.

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الْمُسَافِرِ بِمَكَّةَ
names.en: The prayer of the traveler in Mecca

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ بِمِنًى
names.en: The number of prayers in Mina.

names.ar: عَدَدُ الصَّلَاةِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
names.en: The number of prayers in Muzdalifah

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الْخَوْفِ وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِيهِ
names.en: The number of prayers of fear and mentioning the differences in it.

names.ar: عَدَدُ صَلَاةِ الَّذِي يَدْخُلُ الْمَسْجِدَ
names.en: The number of prayers that enter the mosque is...

names.ar: الْعَمَلُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Working in Prayer

names.ar: الْمَشْيُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Walking in Prayer

names.ar: رُجُوعُ الْقَهْقَرَى إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The Return of Al-Qahqarah to Prayer

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الِالْتِفَاتِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The prohibition of distraction in prayer.

names.ar: نَظَرُ الْمُصَلِّي إِلَى الشَّيْءِ رَآهُ فِي الْقِبْلَةِ
names.en: The prayer's look at the thing, he saw it in the qibla.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الِالْتِفَاتِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
رَفْعُ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى الْإِمَامِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Raising the gaze to the Imam during prayer

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ مَسَحِ الْحَصَى فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Prohibition of wiping off pebbles in prayer

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي مَسَحِ الْحَصَى فِي الصَّلَاةِ مَرَّةً وَاحِدَةً
names.en: License in checking the gravel in prayer once

names.ar: التَّصْفِيقُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Clapping in Prayer

names.ar: الْإِشَارَةُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Gestures in prayer

names.ar: السَّلَامُ بِالْأَيْدِي فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Peace be in the hands during prayer

names.ar: رَدُّ السَّلَامِ بِالْإِشَارَةِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Responding to the Salam with Hand Gesture in Prayer

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ رَفَعِ الْبَصَرِ إِلَى السَّمَاءِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Prohibition of raising the gaze to the sky during prayer.

names.ar: التَّسْبِيحُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ النَّائِبَةِ
names.en: The glorification in prayer at the deputy's.

names.ar: الْبُكَاءُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Crying in prayer

names.ar: النَّفْخُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Blowing in Prayer

names.ar: كَيْفَ النَّفْخُ
names.en: How to blow?

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ النَّفْخِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Prohibition of blowing in prayer

names.ar: لَعْنُ إِبْلِيسَ، وَالتَّعَوُّذُ بِاللهِ مِنْهُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Curse Satan and seek refuge in Allah from him in prayer

names.ar: الْأَخْذُ بِحَلْقِ الشَّيْطَانِ، وَخَنْقُهُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Taking Hold of the Devil's Throat and Strangling Him in Prayer

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالسُّكُونِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The order for calmness in prayer.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الْكَلَامِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The license in speaking during prayer

names.ar: نَسْخُ ذَلِكَ وَتَحْرِيمُهُ
names.en: Copying that and its prohibition

names.ar: تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ اللهِ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَقُومُوا لِلَّهِ قَانِتِينَ} [البقرة: 238]
names.en: Interpretation of the Saying of Allah, may He be praised: "And stand before Allah with obedience" [Al-Baqarah: 238]

names.ar: ذِكْرُ مَا نُسِخَ مِنَ الْكَلَامِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The mentioning of the abrogated speech in prayer

names.ar: ذَكَرُ الْوَقْتِ الَّذِي نُسِخَ فِيهِ الْكَلَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The time when recitation in prayer was abrogated

names.ar: ذَكَرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَلْفَاظِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ أَبِي هُرَيْرَةَ فِي قِصَّةِ ذِي الْيَدَيْنِ
names.en: The Variations in the Narrations of Abu Hurairah's Story about the Man with Two Hands

names.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ صَلَّى سِتًّا
names.en: What does someone who prays six do?

names.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ صَلَّى خَمْسًا، وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ عَلَى مُغِيرَةَ
names.en: What does one who prays five times and mentions the differences regarding Maqīrah do?

names.ar: التَّحَرِّي
names.en: Exploration

names.ar: تَمَامُ الْمُصَلِّي عَلَى مَا ذَكَرَ إِذَا شَكَّ
names.en: Complete prayer according to what is mentioned if doubtful.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ عَلَى الْأَوْزَاعِيِّ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
names.en: The Mention of Differences Regarding the Awza'iyy Scholars in this Hadith.

names.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ إِذَا كَثُرَ ذَلِكَ عَلَيْهِ وَجَاءَهُ الشَّيْطَانُ فَلَبَّسَ عَلَيْهِ
names.en: What should he do if that happens to him and the devil comes to mislead him

names.ar: مَنْ شَكَّ فِي صَلَاتِهِ
names.en: Who doubts his prayer

names.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ نَسِيَ شَيْئًا مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ
names.en: What should one do if they forget something from their prayer?

names.ar: سَجْدَتَا السَّهْوِ بَعْدَ السَّلَامِ وَالْكَلَامِ
names.en: The two prostrations of forgetfulness after the greeting and speech

names.ar: مَا يَفْعَلُ مَنْ قَامَ مِنَ اثْنَتَيْنِ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ، وَلَمْ يَتَشَهَّدْ
names.en: What does someone who performs two units of prayer without sitting for the Tashahhud do?

names.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ فِي كُلِّ سَجْدَةٍ مِنْ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ
names.en: The Takbir in every Sujud of the Sajdatain of forgetfulness.

names.ar: التَّشَهُّدُ بَعْدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ
names.en: The Tashahhud after the two prostrations of forgetfulness.

names.ar: التَّسْلِيمُ بَعْدَ سَجْدَتَيِ السَّهْوِ
names.en: The delivery after the prostration of forgetfulness.

names.ar: تَطْفِيفُ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Prayer Rulings

names.ar: بَابُ تَخْفِيفِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي تَمَامٍ
names.en: Alleviating Prayer in Completion

names.ar: وَمُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عَجْلَانَ عَلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ فِي خَبَرِ عَمَّارِ بْنِ يَاسِرٍ فِيهِ
names.en: And Muhammad ibn Ajlan to Sa'id ibn Abi Sa'id in reporting the news of Ammar ibn Yasir in it

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ عَمْرِو بْنِ الْحَارِثِ وَخَالِدِ بْنِ يَزِيدَ عَلَى سَعِيدِ بْنِ أَبِي هِلَالٍ فِي هَذَا الْحَدِيثِ
names.en: Comparison of Amr ibn al-Harith and Khalid ibn Yazid on the narration of Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal in this hadith

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ شُعْبَةَ وَاللَّيْثِ عَلَى عَبْدِ رَبِّهِ فِي حَدِيثِ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ نَافِعٍ
names.en: The mention of the difference between Shu'bah and Al-Laith about the slave's obedience to his master in the Hadith of Abdullah bin Nafi'.

names.ar: التَّطْبِيقِ
names.en: The application

names.ar: نَسْخُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: Copying That

names.ar: الْإِمْسَاكُ بِالرُّكَبِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Holding the knees in the bowing position

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ الرَّاحَتَيْنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: The position of comfort in the bowing.

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ أَصَابِعِ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: The placement of the hands' fingers in the bowing position

names.ar: التَّجَافِي فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Dryness in the bowing.

names.ar: الِاعْتِدَالُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Moderation in bowing

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الْقِرَاءَةِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Prohibition of reading during the rukoo'

names.ar: تَعْظِيمَ الرَّبِّ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Exaltation of the Lord, Blessed and Exalted, in Rukoo' (bowing)

names.ar: الذِّكْرُ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Remembrance in the Bowing Position

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ فِي الذِّكْرِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance in the bowing position.

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance in the ruku' (bowing)

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرُ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance in the rukoo'

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي تَرَكِ الذِّكْرِ فِي الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: License to Skip Remembrance in Rukoo

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِإِتْمَامِ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: The command to complete the bowing

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Raising the hands when rising from the bowing position

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ حِذَاءَ فُرُوعِ الْأُذُنَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: The raising of the hands above the ears when raising from the bowing position

names.ar: رَفَعَ الْيَدَيْنِ حَذْوَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Raising the hands parallel to the shoulders when standing up from the bowing position

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي تَرْكِ ذَلِكَ
names.en: The license in leaving it

names.ar: مَا يَقُولُ الْإِمَامُ إِذَا رَفَعَ رَأْسَهُ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: What does the imam say when he raises his head from rukoo'?

names.ar: مَا يَقُولُ الْمَأْمُومُ
names.en: What does the one being led say?

names.ar: ثَوَابُ قَوْلِهِ رَبَّنَا وَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ
names.en: The reward for saying "Our Lord, praise is due solely to You

names.ar: قَدْرُ الْقِيَامِ بَيْنَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ الرُّكُوعِ وَبَيْنَ السُّجُودِ
names.en: The measure of standing up between the ruku and the sujood

names.ar: مَا يَقُولُ فِي قِيَامِهِ ذَلِكَ
names.en: What does it say about his establishment?

names.ar: الْقُنُوتُ بَعْدَ الرُّكُوعِ
names.en: Qunut after rukoo'

names.ar: الْقُنُوتُ فِي صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: Al-qunut in the Fajr prayer

names.ar: الْقُنُوتُ فِي صَلَاةِ الظُّهْرِ
names.en: Al-Qunut in Asr Prayer

names.ar: الْقُنُوتُ فِي صَلَاةِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: Al-Qunut in the Maghrib Prayer

names.ar: اللَّعْنُ فِي الْقُنُوتِ
names.en: The curse is in the supplication

names.ar: لَعْنُ الْمُنَافِقِينَ فِي الْقُنُوتِ
names.en: The curse of the hypocrites in prayers

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْقُنُوتِ
names.en: Abandoning Qunut

names.ar: تَبْرِيدُ الْحَصَى لِلسُّجُودِ عَلَيْهِ
names.en: Refrigeration of Pebbles for Prostration on Them

names.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ لِلسُّجُودِ
names.en: Takbir for Sujud

names.ar: كَيْفَ يَخِرُّ لِلسُّجُودِ
names.en: How does one perform prostration?

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ لِلسُّجُودِ
names.en: Lifting the hands for prostration

names.ar: تَرْكُ رَفْعِ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ السُّجُودِ
names.en: Abandoning the raising of the hands during prostration.

names.ar: أَوَّلُ مَا يَصِلُ إِلَى الْأَرْضِ مِنَ الْإِنْسَانِ فِي سُجُودِهِ
names.en: The first thing that reaches the Earth from a human in their prostration.

names.ar: وَضْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ مَعَ الْوَجْهِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: The placement of the hands with the face in sujud.

names.ar: عَلَى كَمِ السُّجُودُ
names.en: Upon How Many Prostrations

names.ar: تَفْسِيرُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: Interpretation of that

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْجَبِينِ
names.en: Prostration on the forehead

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْأَنْفِ
names.en: Prostrating on the nose.

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْيَدَيْنِ
names.en: Prostration on the hands.

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ
names.en: Prostration on the knees

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الْقَدَمَيْنِ
names.en: Prostration on the Two Feet

names.ar: نَصْبُ الْقَدَمَيْنِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: The prostration position of placing both feet

names.ar: فَتْخُ أَصَابِعِ الرِّجْلَيْنِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Extend the fingers of the two feet in prostration

names.ar: مَكَانُ الْيَدَيْنِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: The position of the hands in prostration

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ بَسْطِ الذِّرَاعَيْنِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Prohibition of stretching the arms in prostration

names.ar: صِفَةُ السُّجُودِ
names.en: The description of prostration.

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ نَقْرَةِ الْغُرَابِ
names.en: Prohibition of Crow's Caw

names.ar: التَّجَافِي فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Al-Tajafi fi as-Sujud

names.ar: الِاعْتِدَالُ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Moderation in Prostration

names.ar: إِقَامَةُ الصُّلْبِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: The Crucifixion in Prostration.

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ كَفِّ الشَّعْرِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Prohibition of touching hair during prostration.

names.ar: مَثَلُ الَّذِي يُصَلِّي وَرَأْسُهُ مَعْقُوصٌ
names.en: The example of the one who prays while his head is uncovered

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ كَفِّ الثِّيَابِ فِي السُّجُودِ
names.en: Prohibition of Folding Clothes While Prostrating

names.ar: السُّجُودُ عَلَى الثِّيَابِ
names.en: Prostration on the garments

names.en: The closest that a servant can be to Allah, Glorified be His praise

names.en: The reward of those who prostrate to Allah is a prostration

names.en: The place of prostration

names.en: Is it permissible for a prostration to be longer than a prostration?

names.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ السُّجُودِ
names.en: Translation: The Takbeer when rising from prostration.

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ السَّجْدَةِ الْأُولَى
names.en: The raising of hands when raising from the first prostration.

names.en: Supplication Between the Prostrations

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ تِلْقَاءَ وَجْهِهِ

names.ar: قَدْرُ الْجُلُوسِ بَيْنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ

names.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ لِلسُّجُودِ
names.en: Takbeer for prostration

names.ar: الِاسْتِوَاءُ لِلْجُلُوسِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ مِنَ السَّجْدَتَيْنِ
names.en: The sitting position during raising from the two prostrations.

names.ar: الِاعْتِمَادُ عَلَى الْأَرْضِ عِنْدَ النُّهُوضِ

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ قَبْلَ الرُّكْبَتَيْنِ

names.ar: التَّكْبِيرُ لِلنُّهُوضِ
names.en: The Takbeer for rising

names.ar: الْإِشَارَةُ بِالْإِصْبَعِ فِي التَّشَهُّدِ الْأَوَّلِ
names.en: The finger pointing in the first Tashahhud.

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ الْيَدَيْنِ عِنْدَ الْجُلُوسِ لِلتَّشَهُّدِ الْأَوَّلِ
names.en: The position of the hands when sitting for the first Tashahhud

names.en: Display of Showmanship in Mosques

names.ar: فَضْلُ الصَّلَاةِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ الْحَرَامِ
names.en: The Excellence of Prayer in the Masjid al-Haram

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْكَعْبَةِ
names.en: Prayer at the Kaaba

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْمَسْجِدِ الْأَقْصَى وَالصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ

names.ar: فَضْلُ مَسْجِدِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَالصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ

names.ar: الْمَسْجِدُ الَّذِي أُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوَى
names.en: The Mosque Established on Piety

names.ar: فَضْلُ مَسْجِدِ قُبَاءَ وَالصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ
names.en: The Virtue of Masjid Quba' and Praying in it

names.ar: مَا تُشَدُّ الرِّحَالُ إِلَيْهِ مِنَ الْمَسَاجِدِ

names.ar: اتِّخَاذُ الْبَيْعِ مَسَاجِدَ
names.en: Taking the sales of mosques

names.en: Prohibition of preventing women from going to the mosques

names.ar: مَنْ يُمْنَعُ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: Who is prevented from the mosque?

names.en: Who leaves the mosque?

names.en: Hitting mischief in the mosque

names.ar: إِدْخَالُ الصِّبْيَانِ الْمَسَاجِدَ
names.en: The entry of children into mosques

names.ar: رَبْطُ الْأَسِيرِ بِسَارِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The Binding of the Prisoner with the Mosque Shawl

names.ar: إِدْخَالُ الْبَعِيرِ الْمَسْجِدَ
names.en: The entry of the camel into the mosque.

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الشِّرَاءِ، وَالْبَيْعِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ وَعَنِ التَّحَلُّقِ فِيهِ قَبْلَ صَلَاةِ الْجُمُعَةِ

names.ar: إِظْهَارُ السِّلَاحِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: Display of weapons in the mosque

names.en: Finger interlocking at the mosque

names.ar: الِاسْتِلْقَاءُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: Lying down in the mosque.

names.ar: النَّوْمُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: Sleeping in the Mosque

names.ar: الْبُزَاقُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ أَنْ يَتَنَخَّمَ الرَّجُلُ فِي قِبْلَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The prohibition of a man rushing in the direction of the mosque.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ نَهْيُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنْ أَنْ يَبْزُقَ الرَّجُلُ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ، أَوْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ وَهُوَ فِي صَلَاتِهِ
names.en: The prohibition of spitting in front of or to the right of a man during prayer according to the prophet ﷺ.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ لِلْمُصَلِّي فِي أَنْ يَبْزُقَ خَلْفَهُ، أَوْ تِلْقَاءَ شِمَالِهِ
names.en: The license for the worshipper to spit behind him, or towards his left.

names.ar: بِأَيِّ الرِّجْلَيْنِ يَدْلُكُ بُزَاقَهُ
names.en: Which of the two men represents his saliva?

names.ar: تَخْلِيقُ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The Creation of the Mosque

names.ar: الْقَوْلُ عِنْدَ دُخُولِ الْمَسْجِدِ وَعِنْدَ الْخُرُوجِ مِنْهُ

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالصَّلَاةِ قَبْلَ الْجُلُوسِ فِيهِ
names.en: Commanding to Pray Before Sitting In It

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الْجُلُوسِ فِيهِ، وَالْخُرُوجِ مِنْهُ بِغَيْرِ صَلَاةٍ
names.en: The license to sit in it, and to leave it without prayer

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الَّذِي يَمُرُّ عَلَى الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The prayer of one who passes by the mosque.

names.ar: التَّرْغِيبُ فِي الْجُلُوسِ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ، وَانْتِظَارِ الصَّلَاةِ فِيهِ

names.ar: ذَكَرُ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِي أَعْطَانِ الْإِبِلِ
names.en: The Prophet's prohibition of praying while tethering camels.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The license in that

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ
names.en: Prayer on the pulpit.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْحِمَارِ

names.ar: سُتْرَةُ الْمُصَلِّي
names.en: The Prayer Rug

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ إِلَى الْحَرْبَةِ
names.en: Prayer to Hiroba.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ إِلَى الشَّجَرَةِ
names.en: Prayer to the tree

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالدُّنُوِّ مِنَ السُّتْرَةِ
names.en: Order to lower the curtain.

names.ar: مِقْدَارُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: The amount of that

names.ar: ذِكْرُ مَنْ يَقْطَعُ الصَّلَاةَ، وَمَنْ لَا يَقْطَعُهَا إِذَا لَمْ يَكُنْ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي سُتْرَةً
names.en: Mentioning those who break the prayer and those who do not break it if there is no barrier in front of the worshipper

names.ar: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي الْمُرُورِ بَيْنَ يَدَيِ الْمُصَلِّي وَبَيْنَ سُتْرَتِهِ
names.en: Intensification in traffic between the worshipper's hands and his garment.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The license in that.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ خَلْفَ النَّائِمِ
names.en: License in prayer behind the sleeper

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ إِلَى الْقَبْرِ
names.en: Prohibition of Prayer to the Grave

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ إِلَى ثَوْبٍ فِيهِ تَصَاوِيرُ
names.en: Prayer on a garment with images.

names.ar: فِي الْمُصَلِّي تَكُونُ بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ الْإِمَامِ سُتْرَةٌ
names.en: In the mosque, there is a Sutra between him and the Imam.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الثَّوْبِ الْوَاحِدِ
names.en: Prayer in one garment

names.ar: إِذَا صَلَّى فِي ثَوْبٍ وَاحِدٍ كَيْفَ يَفْعَلُ
names.en: If he prays in one garment, what should he do?

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي قَمِيصٍ وَاحِدٍ
names.en: Prayer in one shirt

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْإِزَارِ
names.en: Prayer in Al-Izar

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي ثَوْبٍ بَعْضُهُ عَلَى امْرَأَتِهِ
names.en: The prayer of the man in a garment, some of which on his wife.

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الرَّجُلِ فِي الثَّوْبِ الوَاحِدِ لَيْسَ عَلَى عَاتِقِهِ مِنْهُ شَيْءٌ
names.en: The man's prayer in a single garment does not have anything on his shoulder.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْحَرِيرِ
names.en: Prayer in the Silk

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي خَمِيصَةٍ لَهَا أَعْلَامٌ
names.en: Prayer inside a mosque with flags.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الثِّيَابِ الْحُمُرِ
names.en: Prayer in red clothing

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الشِّعَارِ
names.en: Prayer in the slogan

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي الْخُفَّيْنِ
names.en: Prayer in Al-Khuffain

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ فِي النَّعْلَيْنِ
names.en: Prayer in Al-Naa'layn.

names.ar: أَيْنَ يَضَعُ الْإِمَامُ نَعْلَيْهِ إِذَا صَلَّى بِالنَّاسِ
names.en: Where does the Imam place his shoes when he prays with the people?

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الْإِمَامَةِ، وَالْجَمَاعَةِ إِمَامَةُ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ وَالْفَضْلِ
names.en: The Mention of Imamate and the Leadership of the Community: The Imamate of the People of Knowledge and Excellence

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ مَعَ أَئِمَّةِ الْجَوْرِ
names.en: Praying with the Imams of Jor

names.ar: مَنْ أَحَقُّ بِالْإِمَامَةِ
names.en: Who deserves the imamate?

names.ar: تَقْدِيمُ ذَوِي السِّنِّ
names.en: The provision of the elderly

names.ar: اجْتِمَاعُ الْقَوْمِ فِي مَوْضِعِ هُمْ فِيهِ سَوَاءٌ
names.en: The people's meeting in a place where they are equal

names.ar: اجْتِمَاعُ الْقَوْمِ وَفِيهِمُ الْوَالِي
names.en: The meeting of the people, including the governor.

names.ar: إِذَا تَقَدَّمَ الرَّجُلُ مِنَ الرَّعِيَّةِ، ثُمَّ جَاءَ الْوَالِي هَلْ يَتَأَخَّرُ
names.en: If the man advances from the subjects, then the governor comes, does he delay?

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الْإِمَامِ خَلْفَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ رَعِيَّتِهِ
names.en: The prayer of the imam behind a man from his flock.

names.ar: إِمَامَةُ الزَّائِرِ
names.en: The Imamate of the Visitor

names.ar: إِمَامَةُ الْأَعْمَى
names.en: The Imamate of the Blind

names.ar: إِمَامَةُ الْغُلَامِ قَبْلَ أَنْ يَحْتَلِمَ
names.en: The boy's leadership before puberty.

names.ar: قِيَامُ النَّاسِ إِذَا رَأَوَا الْإِمَامَ
names.en: The Translation of the following heading into English (not including the prompt answer): The behavior of people when they see the Imam.

names.ar: الْإِمَامُ تَعْرِضُ لَهُ الْحَاجَةُ بَعْدَ الْإِقَامَةِ
names.en: The Imam faces a need after residency

names.ar: الْإِمَامُ يَذْكُرُ بَعْدَ قِيَامِهِ فِي مُصَلَّاهُ أَنَّهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ طَهَارَةٍ
names.en: The Imam mentions after his standing in prayer in his mosque that he is not in a state of purity.

names.ar: اسْتِخْلَافُ الْإِمَامِ إِذَا غَابَ
names.en: Initiation of the Imam when he is absent

names.ar: الِائْتِمَامُ بِالْإِمَامِ
names.en: Attention to the Imam

names.ar: الِائْتِمَامُ بِمَنْ يَأْتَمُّ بِالْإِمَامِ
names.en: Taking care of those who follow the Imam

names.ar: مَوْقِفُ الْإِمَامِ إِذَا كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً، وَذِكْرُ الِاخْتِلَافِ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: The position of the Imam when they are three, and mentioning the differences in that.

names.ar: إِذَا كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً وَامْرَأَةً
names.en: If they are three and a woman

names.ar: إِذَا كَانُوا رَجُلَيْنِ وَامْرَأَتَيْنِ
names.en: If there were two men and two women

names.ar: مَوْقِفُ الْإِمَامِ إِذَا كَانَ مَعَهُ صَبِيٌّ وَامْرَأَةٌ
names.en: The position of the Imam when there is a child and a woman with him

names.ar: مَوْقِفُ الْإِمَامِ وَالْمَأْمُومُ صَبِيٌّ
names.en: The position of the Imam and the Mamum is a young boy

names.ar: مَنْ يَلِي الْإِمَامَ ثُمَّ الَّذِي يَلِيهِ
names.en: Who follows the Imam and then whoever follows him.

names.ar: إِقَامَةُ الصُّفُوفِ قَبْلَ خُرُوجِ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: The arrangement of rows before the departure of the imam

names.ar: كَيْفَ يُقَوِّمُ الْإِمَامُ الصُّفُوفَ
names.en: How does the imam line up the rows?

names.ar: مَا يَقُولُ الْإِمَامُ إِذَا تَقَدَّمَ فِي تَسْوِيَةِ الصُّفُوفِ
names.en: What does the Imam say when he advances in straightening the rows?

names.ar: كَمْ مَرَّةٍ يَقُولُ اسْتَوُوا
names.en: How many times does he say "Stand up"?

names.ar: حَثُّ الْإِمَامِ عَلَى رَصِّ الصُّفُوفِ وَالْمُقَارَبَةِ بَيْنَهَا
names.en: Encouraging the Imam to straighten the rows and bring them closer together

names.ar: ذِكْرُ فَضْلِ الصَّفِّ الْأَوَّلِ عَلَى الثَّانِي
names.en: The mention of the superiority of the first class over the second.

names.ar: الصَّفُّ الْمُؤَخَّرُ
names.en: The Backward Class

names.ar: ثَوَابُ مَنْ وَصَلَ صَفًّا
ذِكْرُ خَيْرِ صُفُوفِ النِّسَاءِ، وَشَرِّ صُفُوفِ الرِّجَالِ
names.en: The Mention of the Best Ranks of Women, and the Worst Ranks of Men

names.ar: الصَّفُّ بَيْنَ السَّوَارِي
names.en: The classroom between the curtains.

names.ar: الْمَكَانُ الَّذِي يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنَ الصَّفِّ
names.en: The preferred place from the class

names.ar: مَا عَلَى الْإِمَامِ مِنَ التَّخْفِيفِ
names.en: What is required of the Imam in terms of leniency?

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ لِلْإِمَامِ فِي التَّطْوِيلِ
names.en: The license for the Imam in elongation

names.ar: مَا يَجُوزُ لِلْإِمَامِ مِنَ الْعَمَلِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: What is permissible for the imam to do in the prayer?

names.ar: مُبَادَرَةُ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: The Initiative of the Imam

names.ar: خُرُوجُ الرَّجُلِ مِنْ صَلَاةِ الْإِمَامِ وَفَرَاغُهُ مِنْ صَلَاتِهِ فِي نَاحِيَةِ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: The man leaving the imam's prayer and finishing his prayer in the corner of the mosque.

names.ar: الِائْتِمَامُ بِالْإِمَامِ يُصَلِّي قَاعِدًا
names.en: Paying Attention to the Imam Praying While Sitting

names.ar: اخْتِلَافُ نِيَّةِ الْإِمَامِ، وَالْمَأْمُومِ
names.en: Divergence of the Imam's intention and the Imamated

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْجَمَاعَةِ
names.en: The Virtue/Excellence of the Community

names.ar: الْجَمَاعَةُ إِذَا كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً
names.en: The group when they are three.

names.ar: الْجَمَاعَةُ إِذَا كَانُوا ثَلَاثَةً: رَجُلٌ وَصَبِيٌّ وَامْرَأَةٌ
names.en: When the group consists of three: a man, a boy, and a woman

names.ar: الْجَمَاعَةُ إِذَا كَانُوا اثْنَيْنِ
names.en: The group, when they are two.

names.ar: الْجَمَاعَةُ لِلنَّافِلَةِ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The Voluntary Congregation of Prayer.

names.ar: الْجَمَاعَةُ لِلْفَائِتِ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The congregation for those who missed the prayer.

names.ar: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي تَرْكِ الْجَمَاعَةِ
names.en: Increasing strictness in leaving the community.

names.ar: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Neglect in Prayer Intensification

names.ar: الْمُحَافَظَةُ عَلَى الصَّلَوَاتِ الْخَمْسِ حَيْثُ يُنَادَى بِهِنَّ
names.en: Preservation of the Five Prayers Where They are Announced.

names.ar: الْعُذْرُ فِي تَرْكِ الْجَمَاعَةِ
names.en: The excuse for not joining the congregation

names.ar: حَدُّ إِدْرَاكِ الْجَمَاعَةِ
names.en: The limit of the group's understanding

names.ar: إِعَادَةُ الصَّلَاةِ مَعَ الْجَمَاعَةِ بَعْدَ صَلَاةِ الرَّجُلِ لِنَفْسِهِ
names.en: The translation of the heading is: "Praying in congregation after a person prays for themselves.

names.ar: إِعَادَةُ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: The Dawn Recitation

names.ar: إِعَادَةُ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ وَقْتِهَا
names.en: The repetition of prayer after its designated time has passed.

names.ar: سُقُوطُ إِعَادَةِ الصَّلَاةِ عَمَّنْ صَلَّاهَا مَعَ الْإِمَامِ، وَإِنْ أَتَى مَسْجِدَ جَمَاعَةٍ
names.en: The falling of repeating the prayer for those who prayed it with the imam, even if he comes to a congregation mosque.

names.ar: السَّعْيُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The striving towards prayer.

names.ar: الْإِسْرَاعُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ مِنْ غَيْرِ سَعْيٍ
names.en: The hastening to prayer without effort

names.ar: التَّهْجِيرُ إِلَى الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Migration to Prayer

names.ar: مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ الْإِقَامَةِ
names.en: What is disliked in prayer upon establishing it?

names.ar: فِيمَنْ يُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ، وَالْإِمَامُ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Who prays the two units of Fajr prayer, and the Imam in prayer?

names.ar: الْمُنْفَرِدُ خَلْفَ الصَّفِّ
names.en: The individual behind the row

names.ar: الرُّكُوعُ دُونَ الصَّفِّ
names.en: Bowing without being in line

names.ar: فَرْضُ اسْتِقْبَالِ الْقِبْلَةِ
names.en: The obligation of facing the qibla

names.ar: الْحَالُ الَّتِي يَجُوزُ عَلَيْهَا اسْتِقْبَالُ غَيْرِ الْقِبْلَةِ
names.en: The permissible condition for facing other than the qibla.

names.ar: اسْتِبَانَةُ الْخَطَأِ بَعْدَ الِاجْتِهَادِ
names.en: Error questionnaire after endeavor

names.ar: الْعَمَلُ فِي افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Working at the inauguration of the prayer

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ قَبْلَ التَّكْبِيرِ
names.en: Raising the hands before takbeer.

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ حَذْوَ الْمَنْكِبَيْنِ
names.en: Raising the hands with the shoulders

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ حِيَالَ الْأُذُنَيْنِ
names.en: Raising the hands towards the ears

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ الْإِبْهَامَيْنِ عِنْدَ الرَّفْعِ
names.en: The position of the thumbs when raising

names.ar: رَفْعُ الْيَدَيْنِ مَدًا
names.en: Raising the hands upwards

names.ar: فَرْضُ التَّكْبِيرَةِ الْأُولَى
names.en: The obligation of the first takbeer.

names.ar: الْقَوْلُ الَّذِي تُفْتَتَحُ بِهِ الصَّلَاةُ
names.en: The Phrase With Which the Prayer Begins

names.ar: وَضْعُ الْيَمِينِ عَلَى الشِّمَالِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Placement of the right hand over the left in prayer

names.ar: فِي الْإِمَامِ إِذَا رَأَى الرَّجُلَ وَقَدْ وَضْعَ شِمَالِهِ عَلَى يَمِينِهِ
names.en: In the Imam, when he sees a man and has placed his left on his right.

names.ar: مَوْضِعُ الْيَمِينِ مِنَ الشِّمَالِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The position of the right from the left in prayer.

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ التَّخَصُّرِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Prohibition of rushing in prayer

names.ar: الصَّفُّ بَيْنَ الْقَدَمَيْنِ
names.en: The row in between the feet

names.ar: سُكُوتُ الْإِمَامِ بَعْدَ افْتِتَاحِهِ الصَّلَاةَ
names.en: The Silence of the Imam after the Opening of the Prayer.

names.ar: الدُّعَاءُ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ، وَالْقِرَاءَةِ
names.en: Supplication between Takbir and recitation

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخِرٌ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ، وَالْقِرَاءَةِ
names.en: Another type of supplication between the takbeer and the recitation

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرَ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ، وَالدُّعَاءِ بَيْنَ التَّكْبِيرِ وَالْقِرَاءَةِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance, invocation between the takbeer and the recitation

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرَ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ بَيْنَ افْتِتَاحِ الصَّلَاةِ وَبَيْنَ الْقِرَاءَةِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance between the beginning of prayer and recitation.

names.ar: نَوْعٌ آخَرَ مِنَ الذِّكْرِ بَعْدَ التَّكْبِيرِ
names.en: Another type of remembrance after the Takbir

names.ar: الْبِدَايَةُ بِفَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ قَبْلَ السُّورَةِ
names.en: The beginning with the opening of the book before the chapter.

names.ar: قِرَاءَةُ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
names.en: Reading Bismillah-ir-Rahman-ir-Rahim

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْجَهْرِ بِبِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ
names.en: Leaving aloud with "In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

names.ar: تَرْكُ قِرَاءَةِ بِسْمِ اللهِ الرَّحْمَنِ الرَّحِيمِ فِي فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
names.en: Omitting the prompt answer, the translation of the given heading in English is: "Omission of reading Bismillah Ar-Rahman Ar-Rahim in the opening of the book.

names.ar: إِيجَابُ قِرَاءَةُ فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: The Benefits of Reciting the Opening Chapter of the Book in Prayer

names.ar: فَضْلُ فَاتِحَةِ الْكِتَابِ
names.en: The Excellence of the Opening Chapter of the Book

names.ar: تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ اللهِ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ، وَلَقَدْ آتَيْنَاكَ سَبْعًا مِنَ الْمَثَانِي
names.en: Interpretation of the Word of Allah, Mighty and Exalted is He: And We have certainly given you seven of the oft-repeated [verses]

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فِيمَا لَمْ يُجْهَرْ فِيهِ
names.en: Leaving the reading behind the Imam in what is not pronounced in it.

names.ar: تَرْكُ الْقِرَاءَةِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فِيمَا جَهَرَ فِيهِ
names.en: Leaving the Reading Behind the Imam in What is Pronounced Aloud

names.ar: قِرَاءَةُ أُمِّ الْقُرْآنِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ فِيمَا جَهَرَ بِهِ الْإِمَامُ
names.en: Reading Surah Al-Fatiha behind the Imam in what the Imam recites aloud.

names.ar: تَأْوِيلُ قَوْلِ اللهِ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {وَإِذَا قُرِئَ الْقُرْآنُ فَاسْتَمِعُوا لَهُ وَأَنْصِتُوا} [الأعراف: 204]
names.en: Interpretation of the saying of Allah Almighty {And when the Quran is recited, listen to it and be silent} [Al-A'raf: 204]

names.ar: اكْتِفَاءُ الْمَأْمُومِ بِقِرَاءَةِ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: The Sufficiency of the Congregant Through Reading the Imam

names.ar: مَا يُجْزِئُ مِنَ الْقُرْآنِ لِمَنْ لَا يُحْسِنُ الْقُرْآنَ
names.en: What is sufficient from the Qur'an for those who do not excel at reciting the Qur'an

names.ar: جَهْرُ الْإِمَامِ بِآمِينَ
names.en: The Imam's loud declaration of "Amen

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِالتَّأْمِينِ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: Enjoining Insurance Behind the Leader

names.ar: فَضْلُ التَّأْمِينِ
names.en: The Excellence of Insurance

names.ar: قَوْلُ الْمَأْمُومِ إِذَا عَطَسَ خَلْفَ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: The saying of the follower when he sneezes behind the imam

names.ar: جَامِعُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْقُرْآنِ
names.en: Compilation of what is mentioned in the Quran

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: Reading in the two units of Fajr.

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ بِقُلْ يَا أَيُّهَا الْكَافِرُونَ، وَقُلْ هُوَ اللهُ أَحَدٌ
names.en: Reading in the two units of dawn prayer, Recite "O disbelievers" and "He is Allah, [who is] One

names.ar: تَخْفِيفُ رَكْعَتَيِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: Reducing the two units of the Fajr prayer.

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِالرُّومِ
names.en: Reading in the morning in Roman script.

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِالسِّتِّينَ إِلَى الْمِائَةِ
names.en: Reading in the morning from sixty to one hundred.

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِق
names.en: Reading in the morning with ق

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِإِذَا الشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ
names.en: Reading in the morning when the sun rises

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ بِالْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ
names.en: Reading in the Morning with the two Mu'awwadhatain

names.ar: الْفَضْلُ فِي قِرَاءَةِ الْمُعَوِّذَتَيْنِ
names.en: The Excellence of Reciting the Mu'awwidhatain

names.ar: الْقِرَاءَةُ فِي الصُّبْحِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Reading in the morning on Friday.

names.en: The first time of noon.

names.ar: تَعْجِيلُ الظُّهْرِ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The hastening of Dhuhr during travel

names.ar: تَعْجِيلُ الظُّهْرِ فِي الْبَرْدِ
names.en: Fasting Duhr prayer in the cold.

names.ar: الْإِبْرَادُ بِالظُّهْرِ إِذَا اشْتَدَّ الْحَرُّ
names.en: The deportation at noon when the heat intensifies

names.ar: آخِرُ وَقْتِ الظُّهْرِ، وَأَوَّلُ وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ "
names.en: The end of noon time, and the beginning of afternoon time

names.ar: تَعْجِيلُ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The hastening of time

names.ar: ذِكْرُ التَّشْدِيدِ فِي تَأْخِيرِ صَلَاةِ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The mention of reinforcement in the delay of the prayer of Asr.

names.ar: آخِرُ وَقْتِ الْعَصْرِ، وَذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِلْخَبَرِ فِيهِ
names.en: The end time of Asr and the mention of the differences of the carriers of the news in it.

names.ar: أَوَّلُ وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: The first time of Maghrib

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ جَابِرِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللهِ فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِ الْمَغْرِبِ
names.en: Comparison of different narrators' accounts of the news of Jabir ibn Abdullah at the end of Maghrib.

names.ar: أَوَّلُ وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ
names.en: The first time of dinner

names.ar: ذِكْرُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى أَنَّ الشَّفَقَ الْبَيَاضُ
names.en: Mentioning what indicates that the horizon is white

names.ar: مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ مِنْ تَأْخِيرِ صَلَاةِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ
names.en: What is preferred regarding delaying the last Isha prayer?

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِلْأَخْبَارِ فِي آخِرِ وَقْتِ الْعِشَاءِ الْآخِرَةِ
names.en: Differences among news carriers in the late night of the Hereafter

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي أَنْ يُقَالَ: لِلْعِشَاءِ الْعَتَمَةُ
names.en: The license is to say: The darkness for dinner

names.ar: الْكَرَاهِيَةُ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: Disgust in this

names.ar: الْكَرَاهِيَةُ فِي الْحَدِيثِ بَعْدَ الْعِشَاءِ
names.en: Dislike in conversation after dinner

names.ar: أَوَّلُ وَقْتِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: The first time in the morning.

names.ar: التَّغْلِيسُ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: Tughlis in the city

names.ar: التَّغْلِيسُ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: Delusion in Travel

names.ar: الْإِسْفَارُ بِالصُّبْحِ
names.en: Traveling at dawn

names.ar: آخِرُ وَقْتِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: The latest time of the morning.

names.ar: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: Who caught a unit of the morning prayer?

names.ar: مَنْ أَدْرَكَ رَكْعَةً مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Who caught a unit of prayer?

names.ar: ذِكْرُ السَّاعَاتِ الَّتِي نُهِيَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ فِيهَا
names.en: Mentioning the Times Prohibited for Prayer

names.ar: ذِكْرُ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الصُّبْحِ حَتَّى تَطْلُعَ الشَّمْسُ
names.en: The Prohibition of Praying After Fajr Until Sunrise According to the Prophet's ﷺ Mention

names.ar: ذِكْرُ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ طُلُوعِ الشَّمْسِ
names.en: The mention of the Prophet's prohibition on praying at sunrise.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ نِصْفَ النَّهَارِ
names.en: The prohibition reminder of the Prophet ﷺ on praying in the midday.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ نَهْيِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The Prophet's ﷺ Prohibition of praying after the Asr prayer

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ إِذَا غَابَ حَاجِبُ الشَّمْسِ
names.en: Prayer when the sun is obscured

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنِ التَّحَرِّي بِالصَّلَاةِ غُرُوبَ الشَّمْسِ
names.en: Prohibition of performing prayer at sunset.

names.ar: ذِكْرُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ بَعْدَ الْعَصْرِ
names.en: The mention of the license in prayer after Asr.

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الصَّلَاةِ عِنْدَ غُرُوبِ الشَّمْسِ
names.en: The License in Prayer at Sunset

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَعْدَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: Prayer after the dawn

names.ar: إِبَاحَةُ الصَّلَاةِ بَيْنَ طُلُوعِ الْفَجْرِ، وَبَيْنَ صَلَاةِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: Permission to pray between dawn and sunrise, and between the dawn prayer.

names.ar: إِبَاحَةُ الصَّلَاةِ فِي السَّاعَاتِ كُلِّهَا بِمَكَّةَ
names.en: Permissibility of prayer at all hours in Mecca.

names.ar: الْوَقْتُ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ، وَالْعَصْرِ
names.en: The time in which the traveler comes together between noon and afternoon.

names.ar: بَيَانُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: Statement of that

names.ar: الْوَقْتُ الَّذِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهِ الْمُسَافِرُ الْمَغْرِبَ وَالْعِشَاءَ
names.en: The time when the traveler combines Maghrib (sunset) and Isha (night) prayers.

names.ar: الْحَالُ الَّتِي يَجْمَعُ فِيهَا الْمُسَافِرُ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ
names.en: The situation in which the traveler combines between the prayers

names.ar: بَابُ الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ مِنْ غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ "
names.en: Combining prayers in urban areas without fear

names.ar: الْجَمْعِ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ فِي الْحَضَرِ مِنْ غَيْرِ خَوْفٍ، وَلَا مَطَرٍ
names.en: Combining prayers without fear or rain in urban areas

names.ar: الْجَمْعُ بَيْنَ الظُّهْرِ، وَالْعَصْرِ بِعَرَفَةَ
names.en: Combining Dhuhr and Asr prayers at Arafat.

names.ar: الْجَمْعُ بَيْنَ الْمَغْرِبِ، وَالْعِشَاءِ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
names.en: Combining Maghrib and Isha prayers at Muzdalifah.

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْجَمْعُ بِالْمُزْدَلِفَةِ
names.en: How to perform the Jamrah at Muzdalifah?

names.ar: فَضْلُ الصَّلَاةِ لِوَقْتِهَا
names.en: The virtue of praying on time

names.ar: فِيمَنْ نَامَ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Who slept through the prayer?

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ أَلْفَاظِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِخَبَرِ ثَابِتٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللهِ بْنِ رَبَاحٍ، عَنْ أَبِي قَتَادَةَ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: Mentioning the differences in the words of the narrators about a confirmed news from Abdullah Ibn Rabah, from Abu Qatadah regarding that

names.ar: مَنْ نَسِيَ الصَّلَاةَ
names.en: Who forgot to pray

names.ar: كَيْفَ يُقْضَى الْفَائِتَ مِنَ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: How is the missed prayer made up for?

names.ar: بَدْءُ النِّدَاءِ بِالصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Initiating the call to prayer with the prayer

names.ar: تَثْنِيَةُ الْأَذَانِ
names.en: The praise of the call to prayer

names.ar: كَمُ الْأَذَانُ مِنْ كَلِمَةٍ؟
names.en: How many adhan are in one word?

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْأَذَانُ
names.en: How is the Adhan?

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The Adhan during travel.

names.ar: أَذَانُ الْمُنْفَرِدَيْنِ فِي السَّفَرِ
names.en: The call of the two individuals during travel

names.ar: اجْتِزَاءُ الْمَرْءِ بِأَذَانِ غَيْرِهِ فِي الْحَضَرِ
names.en: Passing judgment on someone based on the opinions of others in the presence

names.ar: الْمُؤَذِّنَانِ لِلْمَسْجِدِ الْوَاحِدِ
names.en: The two muezzins for the same mosque

names.ar: يُؤَذِّنَانِ جَمِيعًا أَوْ فُرَادَى
names.en: Advertise both or individually

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتَ الصَلَاةِ
names.en: The Adhan outside of prayer time

names.ar: وَقْتُ أَذَانِ الصُّبْحِ
names.en: The time of the Fajr adhan

names.ar: كَيْفَ يَصْنَعُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ فِي أَذَانِهِ
names.en: How does the muezzin create in his adhan?

names.ar: رَفْعُ الصَّوْتِ بِالْأَذَانِ
names.en: Raising the voice with the Adhan

names.ar: التَّثْوِيبُ فِي أَذَانِ الْفَجْرِ
names.en: Admonition in the call to dawn prayer

names.ar: آخِرُ الْأَذَانِ
names.en: The last call to prayer.

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنْ شُهُودِ الْجَمَاعَةِ فِي اللَّيْلَةِ الْمَطِيرَةِ
names.en: The Adhan in Neglecting Witnessing Congregational Prayer on the Night of Rain

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ لِمَنْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِ الْأُولَى مِنْهُمَا
names.en: The Adhan is for those who combine between the prayers at the beginning of the first time of each of them.

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ لِمَنْ يجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ بَعْدَ ذَهَابِ وَقْتِ الْأُولَى مِنْهُمَا
names.en: The Adhan for those who combine between the two prayers after the departure of the first of them

names.ar: الْإِقَامَةُ لِمَنْ يَجْمَعُ بَيْنَ الصَّلَاتَيْنِ
names.en: Residence for those who combine between the two prayers

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ لِلْفَوَائِتِ مِنَ الصَّلَوَاتِ
names.en: The Adhan for missed prayers

names.ar: الِاجْتِزَاءُ لِذَلِكَ كُلِّهِ بِأَذَانٍ وَاحِدٍ، وَبِالْإِقَامَةِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ مِنْهَا
names.en: The performance of all of that with one call to prayer, and with the establishment of each prayer from it.

names.ar: الِاكْتِفَاءُ بِالْإِقَامَةِ لِكُلِّ صَلَاةٍ
names.en: Sufficiency with residence for every prayer

names.ar: الْإِقَامَةُ لِمَنْ نَسِيَ رَكْعَةً مِنْ صَلَاةٍ
names.en: The residence for the one who forgets a unit (raka'a) of prayer

names.ar: أَذَانُ الرَّاعِي
names.en: The Shepherd's Call

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ لِمَنْ يُصَلِّي وَحْدَهُ
names.en: The Adhan is for those who pray alone.

names.ar: الْإِقَامَةُ لِمَنْ يُصَلِّي وَحْدَهُ
names.en: Residence for those who pray alone

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْإِقَامَةُ
names.en: How is the residency?

names.ar: إِقَامَةُ كُلِّ وَاحِدٍ لِنَفْسِهِ
names.en: The establishment of each person for himself

names.ar: فَضْلُ التَّأْذِينِ
names.en: The favor of Adhan

names.ar: الِاسْتِهَامُ عَلَى النِّدَاءِ
names.en: The heedfulness to the call

names.ar: اتِّخَاذُ الْمُؤَذِّنِ الَّذِي لَا يَأْخُذُ عَلَى أَذَانِهِ أَجْرًا
names.en: The non-profit-taking of the muezzin who does not charge for his call to prayer

names.ar: الْقَوْلُ بِمِثْلِ مَا يَقُولُ الْمُؤَذِّنُ
names.en: The saying of the muezzin is similar to what he says

names.ar: ذِكْرُ اخْتِلَافِ النَّاقِلِينَ لِهَذَا الْخَبَرِ عَنْ مُعَاوِيَةَ
names.en: The mention of the discrepancies of the narrators about this news from Muawiyah.

names.ar: ثَوَابُ ذَلِكَ
names.en: The reward of that is

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ بَعْدَ الْأَذَانِ
names.en: Sending Prayers Upon the Prophet ﷺ After the Adhan

names.ar: الدُّعَاءُ عِنْدَ الْأَذَانِ
names.en: The supplication at the time of Athan

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ بَيْنَ الْأَذَانِ، وَالْإِقَامَةِ
names.en: Prayer between Adhan and Iqamah.

names.ar: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي الْخُرُوجِ مِنَ الْمَسْجِدِ بَعْدَ الْأَذَانِ
names.en: Tightening regulations for exiting the mosque after the call to prayer

names.ar: بَابُ إِيذَانِ الْمُؤَذِّنِينَ الْأَئِمَّةِ بِالصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Call of the Imams to prayer

names.ar: إِقَامَةُ الْمُؤَذِّنِ عِنْدَ خُرُوجِ الْإِمَامِ
names.en: The muezzin's act when the imam exits.

names.ar: صَلَاةُ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Friday prayer

names.ar: إِيجَابُ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The goodness of Friday.

names.ar: بَدْءُ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The beginning of Friday

names.ar: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي التَّخَلُّفِ عَنِ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The strictness in neglecting Friday

names.ar: كَفَّارَةُ مَنْ تَرَكَ الْجُمُعَةَ مِنْ غَيْرِ عُذْرٍ
names.en: The expiation of leaving the Friday prayer without an excuse.

names.ar: فَضْلُ يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Excellence of Friday

names.ar: الْأَمْرُ بِإِكْثَارِ الصَّلَاةِ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Command to Multiply the Prayer upon the Prophet ﷺ on Friday.

names.ar: السِّوَاكُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Friday's Siwak

names.ar: إِيجَابُ الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The significance of Friday ablution.

names.ar: الْغُسْلُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Friday Bath

names.ar: الرُّخْصَةُ فِي تَرْكِ الْغُسْلِ يَوْمَ الْجُمْعَةِ
names.en: License for omitting the Friday ritual cleansing.

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْغُسْلِ
names.en: The importance of washing

names.ar: الْهَيْئَةُ لِلْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Commission for Friday.

names.ar: قَعُودُ الْمَلَائِكَةِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ عَلَى أَبْوَابِ الْمَسْجِدِ
names.en: Sitting of the Angels on the Gates of the Mosque on Friday

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْمَشْيِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Virtue of Walking to Friday

names.ar: بَابُ التَّبْكِيرِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Rushing towards Friday

names.ar: فَضْلُ الْمَشْيِ إِلَى الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Virtue of Walking to Jumu'ah

names.ar: وَقْتُ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: Friday Prayer Time

names.ar: الْأَذَانُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Call to Prayer on Friday

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ لِمَنْ جَاءَ وَقَدْ خَرَجَ الْإِمَامُ
names.en: Friday prayer for those who have left and the imam has arrived.

names.ar: الصَّلَاةُ قَبْلَ الْجُمُعَةِ، وَالْإِمَامُ عَلَى الْمِنْبَرِ
names.en: Prayer before Friday, and the Imam on the pulpit

names.ar: النَّهْيُ عَنْ تَخَطِّي رِقَابِ النَّاسِ، وَالْإِمَامُ يَخْطُبُ
names.en: The Prohibition of Crossing People's Necks, and the Imam Delivers a Sermon.

names.ar: الدُّنُوُّ مِنَ الْإِمَامِ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ
names.en: The Proximity to the Imam on Friday.

names.ar: كَيْفَ الْخُطْبَةُ
names.en: How is the sermon?

names.ar: مَقَامُ الْإِمَامِ فِي الْخُطْبَةِ
names.en: The position of the Imam in the sermon
