Ash-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "And the good things and the evil are only for those who eat them, and they are the Arabs who asked about this, and the rulings were revealed concerning them." He said: "I heard some of the people of knowledge say about the saying of Allah: "Say, 'I do not find within that which was revealed to me [anything] forbidden to one who would eat it" [Al-An'am: 145], meaning: from what you used to eat except for carrion and what is mentioned after it." Ash-Shafi'i said: "And this is the most appropriate understanding supported by the Sunnah.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الضَّبُعِ وَالثَّعْلَبِ
names.en: What is mentioned in the story of the wolf and the fox

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْأَرْنَبِ
names.en: What is mentioned in the hare?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي حِمَارِ الْوَحْشِ وَمَا أَكَلَتْهُ الْعَرَبُ فِي غَيْرِ ضَرُورَةٍ
names.en: What the wild donkey brought and what the Arabs ate without necessity.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الضَّبِّ
names.en: What came in the lizard?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا رُوِيَ فِي الْقُنْفُذِ وَحَشَرَاتِ الْأَرْضِ
names.en: What has been narrated about the hedgehog and ground insects

names.ar: بَابُ أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ
names.en: Eating horse meat.

names.ar: بَابُ بَيَانِ ضَعْفِ الْحَدِيثِ الَّذِي رُوِيَ فِي النَّهْيِ عَنْ لُحُومِ الْخَيْلِ
names.en: Statement on the Weakness of the Narration Regarding Prohibition of Eating Horse Meat

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْلِ لُحُومِ الْحُمُرِ الْأَهْلِيَّةِ
names.en: What is stated about consuming domesticated red meat?

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْلِ الْجَلَّالَةِ وَأَلْبَانِهَا وَهِيَ الْإِبِلُ الَّتِي يَكُونُ أَكْثَرُ عَلَفِهَا الْعَذِرَةَ، وَأَرْوَاحُ الْعَذِرَةِ تُوجَدُ فِي عِرْقِهَا وَجِرَرِهَا.
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: وَفِي مَعْنَى الْإِبِلِ الْبَقَرُ وَالْغَنَمُ وَغَيْرُهُمَا مِمَّا يُؤْكَلُ.
names.en:
What is mentioned about the food of Al-Jallalah and its milk, which is the camel that most of its fodder is alfalfa, and the spirits of the alfalfa are found in its veins and tendons.
Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: And in the meaning of the camel, it includes cows, sheep, and others that are eaten.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الدَّجَاجِ الَّذِي يَأْكُلُ النَّتِنَ
names.en: What is in the chicken that eats nettles?

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَصْبُورَةِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: وَالْمَصْبُورَةُ الشَّاةُ تُرْبَطُ ثُمَّ تُرْمَى بِالنَّبْلِ. وَقَالَ أَبُو عُبَيْدٍ: هُوَ الطَّائِرُ أَوْ غَيْرُهُ مِنْ ذَوَاتِ الرُّوحِ يُصْبَرُ حَيًّا ثُمَّ يُرْمَى حَتَّى يَقْتُلَ , وَأَصْلُ الصَّبْرِ الْحَبْسُ.
names.en: What is mentioned in al-Masboorah?

names.ar: بَابُ ذَكَاةِ مَا فِي بَطْنِ الذَّبِيحَةِ
names.en: The translation of the heading "ذَكَاةِ مَا فِي بَطْنِ الذَّبِيحَةِ" into English is "Zakah of what is in the belly of the slaughtered animal".

names.ar: بَابُ التَّنْزِيهِ عَنْ كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ
names.en: Abstaining from the profession of a cupping therapist

names.ar: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي كَسْبِ الْحَجَّامِ

بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي فَضْلِ الْحِجَامَةِ عَلَى طَرِيقِ الِاخْتِصَارِ
حَدِيثُ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَدْ مَضَى.
names.en: What has been mentioned about the virtue of cupping as a shortcut: The Hadith of Anas ibn Malik.

names.ar: بَابُ مَوْضِعِ الْحِجَامَةِ
names.en: The position of cupping therapy

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي وَقْتِ الْحِجَامَةِ
names.en: What came at the time of cupping

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي اسْتِحْبَابِ تَرْكِ الِاكْتِوَاءِ وَالِاسْتِرْقَاءِ
names.en: What does it say about the recommendation to avoid seeking shade and doing istirqa' (seeking rain)?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِبَاحَةِ قَطْعِ الْعُرُوقِ وَالْكِيِّ عِنْدَ الْحَاجَةِ
names.en: What is permitted regarding bloodletting and cupping in times of necessity.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِبَاحَةِ التَّدَاوِي
names.en: What is said about the permissibility of medication

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الِاحْتِمَاءِ
names.en: What is mentioned in the shelter?

names.ar: بَابُ أَدْوِيَةِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ سِوَى مَا مَضَى فِي الْبَابِ قَبْلَهُ
names.en: The medicines of the Prophet  ﷺ  except for what has been mentioned in the previous chapter before it

names.ar: بَابُ لَا تُكْرِهُوا مَرْضَاكُمْ عَلَى الطَّعَامِ وَالشَّرَابِ
names.en: Do not force your patients on food and drink.

names.ar: بَابُ إِبَاحَةِ الرُّقْيَةِ بِكِتَابِ اللهِ ﷻ وَبِمَا يُعْرَفُ مِنْ ذِكْرِ اللهِ
names.en: Permissibility of Ruqyah with the Book of Allah and Known Remembrance of Allah

names.ar: بَابُ التَّمَائِمِ
names.en: The charms or talismans

names.ar:
بَابُ النُّشْرَةِ
قَالَ أَبُو سُلَيْمَانَ: النُّشْرَةُ ضَرْبٌ مِنَ الرُّقْيَةِ وَالْعِلَاجِ يُعَالَجُ بِهِ مَنْ كَانَ يَظُنُّ مَسَّ الْجِنِّ , وَقِيلَ: سُمِّيَتْ نُشْرَةً لِأَنَّهُ يَنْشُرُهَا عَنْهُ , أَيْ يُحِلُّ عَنْهُ مَا خَامَرَهُ مِنَ الدَّاءِ.
names.en: The bulletin

names.ar: بَابُ الِاسْتِغْسَالِ لِلْمَعِينِ
names.en: Wudu for the Soiled

names.ar: بَابُ السَّمْنِ أَوِ الزَّيْتِ تَمُوتُ فِيهِ فَأْرَةٌ
names.en: Butter or oil kills a mouse in it

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لَا يَجُوزُ بَيْعُ مَا نَجُسَ مِنْهُ
اسْتِدْلَالًا بِقَوْلِهِ: " أَلْقُوهَا وَمَا حَوْلَهَا " , وَقَوْلِهِ: " وَإِنْ كَانَ مَائِعًا فَلَا تَقْرَبُوهُ ".
names.en:
Who said: "It is not permissible to sell what is impure from it"
As evidence by his saying: "Pour it and what surrounds it" and his saying: "And if it is a liquid, do not approach it.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ أَبَاحَ الِاسْتِصْبَاحَ بِهِ
names.en: Who allowed the use of استصباح?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ مَنَعَ الِانْتِفَاعَ بِهِ
names.en: Who prevented benefiting from it?

names.ar: بَابُ تَحْرِيمِ أَكْلِ السُّمِّ الْقَاتِلِ
names.en: The Prohibition of Eating Deadly Poison

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْلِ التِّرْيَاقِ
names.en: What is mentioned in the food of treachery?

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ مِنَ الْمَيْتَةِ بِالضَّرُورَةِ
قَالَ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: {وَقَدْ فَصَّلَ لَكُمْ مَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ إِلَّا مَا اضْطُرِرْتُمْ إِلَيْهِ} [الأنعام: 119]، وَقَالَ: {إِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيْكُمُ الْمَيْتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحْمَ الْخِنْزِيرِ وَمَا أُهِلَّ بِهِ لِغَيْرِ اللهِ فَمَنِ اضْطُرَّ غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ فَلَا إِثْمَ عَلَيْهِ} [البقرة: 173]. قَالَ مُجَاهِدٌ: {غَيْرَ بَاغٍ وَلَا عَادٍ} [البقرة: 173] يَقُولُ: غَيْرَ قَاطَعٍ السَّبِيلَ وَلَا مُفَارِقٍ الْأَئِمَّةَ وَلَا خَارِجٍ فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللهِ جَلَّ جَلَالُهُ.
names.en:
What is permissible from the dead necessarily
God, may He be praised and exalted, said: "He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit], there is no sin upon him." [Al-Baqarah: 173]. Mujahid said: "neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit]" [Al-Baqarah: 173] means: not cutting off the path or separating from the imams or being outside the disobedience of Allah, may His Majesty be glorified.

names.ar: بَابُ تَحْرِيمِ أَكْلِ مَالِ الْغَيْرِ بِغَيْرِ إِذْنِهِ
names.en: Prohibition of consuming someone else's property without their permission

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ مَرَّ بِحَائِطِ إِنْسَانٍ أَوْ مَاشِيَتِهِ
names.en: What happened to someone passing by a wall, or his walking?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ لِلْمُضْطَرِّ مِنْ مَالِ الْغَيْرِ
names.en: What is permissible for the one in need from someone else's money?

names.ar: بَابُ: صَاحِبُ الْمَالِ لَا يَمْنَعُ الْمُضْطَرَّ فَضْلًا، إِنْ كَانَ عِنْدَهُ
names.en: The Wealthy Person Does Not Deny the Needy out of Kindness, If He Has

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ مِنَ الْأَدْوِيَةِ النَّجِسَةِ بِالضَّرُورَةِ
names.en: What is necessarily permissible from impure medicines

names.ar: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّدَاوِي بِالْمُسْكِرِ
names.en: The prohibition of using intoxicants as medicine

names.ar: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّدَاوِي بِمَا يَكُونُ حَرَامًا فِي غَيْرِ حَالِ الضَّرُورَةِ
names.en: Prohibition of seeking treatment through what is forbidden except in cases of necessity.

names.ar: بَابُ أَكْلِ الْجُبْنِ
names.en: Cheese consumption

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَحِلُّ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ , وَمَا لَا يَحِلُّ
names.en: What is permissible from cheese and what is not permissible

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْكَبِدِ وَالطِّحَالِ
names.en: What is found in the liver and spleen

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ الشَّاةِ إِذَا ذُبِحَتْ
names.en: What is disliked of the sheep when it is slaughtered

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا حُرِّمَ عَلَى بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ , ثُمَّ وَرَدَ عَلَيْهِ النَّسْخُ بِشَرِيعَةِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ
قَالَ: الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ قَالَ اللهُ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: {كُلُّ الطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِبَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَائِيلُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ} [آل عمران: 93] الْآيَةَ
names.en:
What was forbidden to the children of Israel, and then abrogated by the legislation of our Prophet Muhammad  ﷺ 
Al-Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him) said: Allah, may He be blessed and exalted, said: "All food was lawful to the children of Israel except what Israel had made unlawful to himself." [Al-Imran: 93] the verse.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا حَرَّمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: حَرَّمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ مِنْ أَمْوَالِهِمْ أَشْيَاءَ أَبَانَ اللهُ ﷻ، أَنَّهَا لَيْسَتْ حَرَامًا بِتَحْرِيمِهِمْ، وَذَلِكَ مِثْلُ الْبَحِيرَةِ وَالسَّائِبَةِ وَالْوَصِيلَةِ وَالْحَامِ كَانُوا يُنْزِلُونَهَا فِي الْإِبِلِ وَالْغَنَمِ كَالْعِتْقِ، فَيُحَرِّمُونَ أَلْبَانَهَا وَلُحُومَهَا وَمِلْكَهَا، وَسَاقَ الْكَلَامَ فِيهِ , كَمَا هُوَ مَنْقُولٌ فِي الْمَبْسُوطِ
names.en: مَا حَرَّمَ الْمُشْرِكُونَ عَلَى أَنْفُسِهِمْ" translates to "What the polytheists prohibited for themselves.

names.ar: بَابُ اسْتِعْمَالِ أَوَانِي الْمُشْرِكِينَ، وَالْأَكْلِ مِنْ طَعَامِهِمْ
names.en: Use of the utensils of the polytheists and eating from their food.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي أَكْلِ الطِّينِ , قَدْ رُوِيَ فِي تَحْرِيمِهِ أَحَادِيثُ لَا يَصِحُّ شَيْءٌ مِنْهَا
names.en: What is mentioned regarding the consumption of clay, as there are narrations about its prohibition in which nothing is considered valid.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا لَمْ يُذْكَرْ تَحْرِيمُهُ، وَلَا كَانَ فِي مَعْنَى مَا ذُكِرَ تَحْرِيمُهُ مِمَّا يُؤْكَلُ أَوْ يُشْرَبُ
names.en: Unless it is mentioned to be forbidden, and it is not within the meaning of what was mentioned to be forbidden from what is eaten or drank

names.ar: كِتَابُ السَّبْقِ وَالرَّمْيِ
names.en: al-Sunan al-Kabir, Bayhaqi

names.ar:
بَابُ التَّحْرِيضِ عَلَى الرَّمْيِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ فِيمَا نَدَبَ بِهِ أَهْلَ دِينِهِ: {وَأَعِدُّوا لَهُمْ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُمْ مِنْ قُوَّةٍ وَمِنْ رِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ تُرْهِبُونَ بِهِ عَدُوَّ اللهِ وَعَدُوَّكُمْ} [الأنفال: 60] فَزَعَمَ أَهْلُ الْعِلْمِ بِالتَّفْسِيرِ، أَنَّ الْقُوَّةَ هِيَ الرَّمْيُ
names.en:
Incitement to Throwing
Imam Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Allah, may He be glorified, said in what he recommended to the people of his religion: "And prepare against them whatever power you can and of the tethered horses by which you may terrify the enemy of Allah and your enemy" [Surah Al-Anfal: 60]. The people of knowledge claimed in their interpretation that "power" refers to throwing.

names.ar: بَابُ ارْتِبَاطِ الْخَيْلِ عُدَّةً فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ ﷻ
names.en: Horse Riding for the sake of Allah ﷻ

names.ar: بَابُ لَا سَبْقَ إِلَّا فِي خُفٍّ أَوْ حَافِرٍ أَوْ نَصْلٍ
names.en: There is no place for (ahead) except in a saddle, shoe, or blade.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُسَابَقَةِ بِالْعَدْوِ
names.en: What was in the competition with the enemy?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمُصَارَعَةِ
names.en: What came in wrestling

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي اللَّعِبِ بِالْحَمَامِ
names.en: What is in playing with pigeons?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْوَالِي يُسْبِقُ بَيْنَ الْخَيْلِ مِنْ غَايَةٍ إِلَى غَايَةٍ
names.en: What Comes in Between the Horse and Its Destination

names.ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلَيْنِ يَسْتَبِقَانِ بِفَرَسَيْهِمَا، وَيَخْرُجُ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا سَبْقًا، وَيُدْخِلَانِ بَيْنَهُمَا مُحَلِّلًا عَلَى أَنَّهُ إِنْ سَبَقَهُمَا الْمُحَلِّلُ، كَانَ مَا أَخْرَجَاهُ لَهُ، وَإِنْ سَبَقَ أَحَدُهُمَا الْمُحَلِّلَ أَحْرَزَ مَالَهُ، وَأَخَذَ مَالَ صَاحِبِهِ
names.en: The two men race with their horses and each one of them goes out ahead, and they both enter in between as equals, assuming that if the neutral person preceded them, they would give what they took out to him, and if one of them preceded the neutral person, he would keep his belongings and take the belongings of his companion.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الرِّهَانِ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ وَمَا يَجُوزُ مِنْهُ وَمَا لَا يَجُوزُ
names.en: What is mentioned in the bet on horses and what is permissible and what is not permissible

names.ar: بَابُ لَا جَلَبَ وَلَا جَنَبَ فِي الرِّهَانِ
names.en: No bringing or taking sides in gambling.

names.ar: بَابُ النَّهْيِ عَنِ التَّحْرِيشِ بَيْنَ الْبَهَائِمِ
names.en: Prohibition of provoking between animals

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ إِنْزَاءِ الْحُمُرِ عَلَى الْخَيْلِ
names.en: Dislike of putting a saddle on a horse

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ خِصَاءِ الْبَهَائِمِ
names.en: The Detestability of Animal Castration

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي تَسْمِيَةِ الْبَهَائِمِ وَالدَّوَابِّ
names.en: What is included in the names of animals and creatures?

names.ar: كِتَابُ الْأَيْمَانِ
names.en: Faith

names.ar: بَابُ الْحَلِفِ بِاللهِ ﷻ، أَوْ بِاسْمٍ مِنْ أَسْمَاءِ اللهِ ﷻ
names.en: Taking an Oath by Allah or by One of Allah's Names

names.ar: بَابُ أَسْمَاءِ اللهِ ﷻ ثَنَاؤُهُ
names.en: The Names of Allah ﷻ and His Praises

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْحَلِفِ بِغَيْرِ اللهِ ﷻ
names.en: Dislike of taking an oath with other than Allah.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ بِغَيْرِ اللهِ , ثُمَّ حَنِثَ، أَوْ حَلَفَ بِالْبَرَاءَةِ مِنَ الْإِسْلَامِ، أَوْ بِمِلَّةٍ غَيْرِ الْإِسْلَامِ، أَوْ بِالْأَمَانَةِ
names.en: Who swears by other than Allah, then breaks his oath, or swears by innocence of Islam, or by a religion other than Islam, or by trustworthiness...

names.ar: بَابُ مِنْ كَرِهَ الْأَيْمَانَ بِاللهِ إِلَّا فِيمَا كَانَ لِلَّهِ طَاعَةٌ
names.en: No one hates to swear by Allah except in what is due to Allah's obedience.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَرَأَى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا فَلْيَأْتِ الَّذِي هُوَ خَيْرٌ، وَلْيُكَفِّرْ عَنْ يَمِينِهِ
names.en: Whoever takes an oath and then sees something better than it, should do that which is better and make amends for his oath.

names.ar: بَابُ شُبْهةِ مِنْ زَعَمَ أَنْ لَا كَفَّارَةَ فِي الْيَمِينِ إِذَا كَانَ حِنْثُهَا طَاعَةً
names.en: Doubt of those who claimed that there is no expiation for breaking an oath if it is done in obedience.

names.ar: بَابُ إِبْرَارِ الْقَسَمِ إِذَا كَانَ الْبِرُّ طَاعَةً، أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنِ الْحِنْثُ خَيْرًا مِنَ الْبِرِّ
names.en: The Virtue of Taking an Oath When Piety is Obedience, or When Abstaining is Better than Piety

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْيَمَينِ الْغَمُوسِ
names.en: What does "مَا جَاءَ فِي الْيَمَينِ الْغَمُوسِ" mean in English?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِهِ: أُقْسِمُ , أَوْ أَقْسَمْتُ
names.en: What is said in his statement: I swear, or I have sworn.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِبْرَارِ الْمُقْسِمِ
names.en: What is mentioned in the righteousness of the divider?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لَعَمْرُ اللهِ
names.en: Who said: By the life of God

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي الْحَلِفِ بِصِفَاتِ اللهِ تَعَالَى , كَالْعِزَّةِ , وَالْقُدْرَةِ , وَالْجَلَالِ , وَالْكِبْرِيَاءِ , وَالْعَظَمَةِ , وَالْكَلَامِ , وَالسَّمْعِ , وَنَحْوِ ذَلِكَ
names.en: What is stated in the oath about the attributes of Allah Almighty, such as might, power, glory, grandeur, greatness, speech, hearing, and the like?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: اللهِ لَأَفْعَلَنَّ كَذَا , أَوْ لَمْ أَفْعَلْ كَذَا , يَنْوِي بِهِ يَمِينًا
names.en: Who said: "By Allah, I will do such and such" or "I will not do such and such," intending thereby a vow.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: وَايْمُ اللهِ
names.en: Who said, "By the life of Allah"?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: عَلَيَّ عَهْدُ اللهِ يُرِيدُ بِهِ يَمِينًا
names.en: Who said: "By the covenant of Allah upon me, he desires thereby a right"?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: عَلَيَّ نَذْرٌ , وَلَمْ يُسَمِّ شَيْئًا
names.en: Who said, "I have made a vow," without mentioning anything?

names.ar: بَابُ الِاسْتِثْنَاءِ فِي الْيَمِينِ
names.en: Exception in taking an oath

names.ar: بَابُ صِلَةِ الِاسْتِثْنَاءِ بِالْيَمِينِ
names.en: The exception clause on the right

names.ar: بَابُ الْحَالِفِ يَسْكُتُ بَيْنَ يَمِينِهِ وَاسْتِثْنَائَهِ سَكْتَةً يَسِيرَةً لِانْقَطَاعِ صَوْتٍ، أَوْ أَخْذِ نَفَسٍ
names.en: The affiant remains silent between his right and his exception with a short pause for the interruption of sound, or to take a breath.

names.ar:
بَابُ الْحَالِفِ يَسْتَثْنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ
رُوِّينَا عَنْ إِبْرَاهِيمَ النَّخَعِيِّ أَنَّهُ قَالَ فِي الَّذِي يَحْلِفُ، وَيَسْتَثْنِي فِي نَفْسِهِ، قَالَ: " لَيْسَ بِشَيْءٍ , إِلَّا أَنْ يَظْهَرَ، وَيَتَكَلَّمَ بِهِ "، وَفِي رِوَايَةِ الْجَمَاعَةِ: وُهَيْبٍ، وَعَبْدِ الْوَارِثِ، وَحَمَّادٍ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ: " مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى يَمِينٍ فَقَالَ: إِنْ شَاءَ اللهُ "، كَالدَّلِيلِ عَلَى هَذَا , حَيْثُ عَلَّقَ ذَلِكَ بِالْقَوْلِ، وَرُوِيَ فِيهِ حَدِيثٌ ضَعِيفٌ بِمَرَّةٍ , لَا يُحْتَجُّ بِمِثْلِهِ
names.en:
The Affirmer Excludes Himself
It was narrated from Ibrahim al-Nakhai that he said about the one who swears an oath and excludes himself, he said: "There is nothing [wrong] except if it becomes evident and he speaks with it." And in another narration from Al-Jama'ah: Wahb, Abdul Warith, and Hammad, from Ayyub: "Whoever swears an oath and says: If Allah wills..." it is evidence for this, as it is connected to the statement, and it was narrated in it a weak hadith once, it cannot be relied upon.

names.ar: بَابُ لَغْوِ الْيَمِينِ
names.en: The false oath

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ عَلَى شَيْءٍ , وَهُوَ يَرَى أَنَّهُ صَادِقٌ , ثُمَّ وَجَدَهُ كَاذِبًا
names.en: Who swears on something, thinking he is truthful, then finds it to be false.

names.ar: بَابُ الْكَفَّارَةِ بَعْدَ الْحِنْثِ
names.en: The expiation after the offense

names.ar: بَابُ الْكَفَّارَةِ قَبْلَ الْحِنْثِ
names.en: Atonement before sin

names.ar:
بَابُ الْإِطْعَامِ فِي كَفَّارَةِ الْيَمِينِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {فَكَفَّارَتُهُ إِطْعَامُ عَشَرَةِ مَسَاكِينَ مِنْ أَوْسَطِ مَا تُطْعِمُونَ أَهْلِيكُمْ} [المائدة: 89] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " يُجْزِئُ فِي كَفَّارَةِ الْيَمِينِ مُدٌّ بِمُدِّ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ , لِأَنَّ رَسُولَ اللهِ ﷺ أُتِيَ بِعِرْقِ تَمْرٍ , فَدَفَعَهُ إِلَى رَجُلٍ , وَأَمَرَهُ أَنْ يُطْعِمَهُ سِتِّينَ مِسْكِينًا , وَالْعِرْقُ فِيمَا يُقَدَّرُ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ صَاعًا وَذَلِكَ سِتُّونَ مُدًّا لِكُلِّ مِسْكِينٍ مُدٌّ "
names.en:
Feeding as Expiation for Breaking an Oath
Allah, glorified be He, says, "And its expiation is the feeding of ten needy people from the average of that which you feed your families" [Al-Ma'idah: 89]. Imam Ash-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said, "Expiation for breaking an oath is fulfilled by providing food equivalent to the amount the Prophet ﷺ used to be given. For the Prophet ﷺ was given a cluster of dates, which he handed over to a man and instructed him to feed sixty poor people. And a cluster is estimated to be fifteen sa'. Thus, sixty clusters are allotted for each poor person.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ فِي الشَّيْءِ لَا يَفْعَلُهُ مِرَارًا
names.en: Who Swears an Oath in Something and Does Not Do It Repeatedly

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا يَجْزِئُ مِنَ الْكِسْوَةِ فِي الْكَفَّارَةِ وَهُوَ كُلُّ مَا وَقَعَ عَلَيْهِ اسْمُ كِسْوَةٍ, مِنْ عِمَامَةٍ, أَوْ سَرَاوِيلَ, أَوْ إِزَارٍ, أَوْ مُقَنَّعَةٍ, وَغَيْرِ ذَلِكَ
قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالَى {أَوْ كِسْوَتُهُمْ} [المائدة: 89]
names.en: What is permissible in the atonement from clothing, and it includes everything that is called clothing, such as turbans, pants, wraps, and masks, and others. Allah Almighty said, "Or their clothing" [Al-Ma'idah: 89].

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَجُوزُ فِي عِتْقِ الْكَفَّارَاتِ
names.en: What is permissible regarding the emancipation of slaves?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي وَلَدِ الزِّنَا
names.en: What is mentioned about the son of adultery?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي إِعْتَاقِ وَلَدِ الزِّنَا
names.en: What is mentioned regarding the emancipation of the child of adultery.

names.ar: بَابُ التَّخْيِيرِ بَيْنَ الْإِطْعَامِ وَالْكُسْوَةِ وَالْعِتْقِ , {فَمَنْ لَمْ يَجِدْ فَصِيَامُ ثَلَاثَةِ أَيَّامٍ} [البقرة: 196]
names.en: The choice between food, clothing, and emancipation, {so whoever does not find [enough] food - then fasting for three days} [Surah Al-Baqarah: 196]

names.ar: بَابُ التَّتَابُعِ فِي صَوْمِ الْكَفَّارَةِ
names.en: The succession in the fasting of expiation

names.ar:
بَابُ جَامِعِ الْأَيْمَانِ مَنْ حَنِثَ نَاسِيًا لِيَمِينِهِ أَوْ مُكْرَهًا عَلَيْهِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {إِلَّا مَنْ أُكْرِهَ وَقَلْبُهُ مُطْمَئِنٌّ بِالْإِيمَانِ} [النحل: 106]
names.en: The Mosque of Al-Ayman for those who break their covenant willingly or under compulsion

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ حَلَفَ: لَيَقْضِيَنَّ حَقَّهُ إِلَى حِينٍ , أَوْ إِلَى زَمَانٍ , وَمَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ وَقْتٌ مَعْلُومٌ
names.en: What is mentioned about someone who swears: "He will fulfill his right until a certain time, or until a specific duration, and what is used as evidence that he does not have a specific time.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَقْرُبُ مِنَ الْحِنْثِ , لَا يَكُونُ حِنْثًا احْتَجَّ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا فِي ذَلِكَ بِمَا
names.en: What is close to sin is not sin. Some of our companions argue about that based on what.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ: لَا يَأْكُلُ خُبْزًا بِأَدِمٍ , فَأَكَلَهُ بِمَا يُعَدَّ أَدَمًا فِي الْعَادَةِ , بِمَا يَصْطَبِغُ بِهِ , أَوْ لَا يَصْطَبِغُ
names.en: Who swore not to eat bread with Adam. Afterward, he ate it with something that is commonly considered to be Adam in appearance or something that can be dyed with it, or something that cannot be dyed.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ: لَا يُكَلِّمُ رَجُلًا , فَأَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولًا , أَوْ كَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ كِتَابًا
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {وَمَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَنْ يُكَلِّمَهُ اللهُ إِلَّا وَحْيًا أَوْ مِنْ وَرَاءِ حِجَابٍ أَوْ يُرْسِلَ رَسُولًا فَيُوحِيَ بِإِذْنِهِ مَا يَشَاءُ} [الشورى: 51] وَقَالَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ فِي الْمُنَافِقِينَ {قُلْ لَا تَعْتَذِرُوا لَنْ نُؤْمِنَ لَكُمْ قَدْ نَبَّأَنَا اللهُ مِنْ أَخْبَارِكُمْ} [التوبة: 94] وَإِنَّمَا نَبَّأَهُمْ مِنْ أَخْبَارِهِمْ بِالْوَحْيِ الَّذِي يَنْزِلُ بِهِ جِبْرَائِيلُ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ عَلَى النَّبِيِّ ﷺ , وَيُخْبِرُهُمُ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ بِوَحْيٍ إِلَيْهِ , قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " مَنْ قَالَ لَا يَحْنَثُ , قَالَ: إِنَّ كَلَامَ الْآدَمِيِّينَ لَا يُشْبِهُ كَلَامَ اللهِ , كَلَامُ الْآدَمِيَّينَ بِالْمُوَاجَهَةِ , أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّهُ لَوْ هَجَرَ رَجُلٌ رَجُلًا , كَانَتِ الْهِجْرَةُ مُحَرَّمَةً عَلَيْهِ فَوْقَ ثَلَاثِ لَيَالٍ , فَكَتَبَ إِلَيْهِ , أَوْ أَرْسَلَ إِلَيْهِ رَسُولًا , وَهُوَ يَقْدِرُ عَلَى كَلَامِهِ , لَمْ يُخْرِجْهُ هَذَا مِنْ هِجْرَتِهِ الَّتِي يَأْثَمُ بِهَا؟ "
names.en: Whoever takes an oath: "He shall not speak to a man," so he sends him a messenger or writes him a letter. Allah, may He be glorified, said {And it is not for any human being that Allah should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger to reveal, by His permission, what He wills.}[Surah Ash-Shura: 51] And He said to the believers about the hypocrites {Say, "Do not offer an excuse. We have informed you of the news.}[Surah At-Tawbah: 94] And He informed them about their news through the revelation that Jibril (Gabriel) revealed to him, and the Prophet  ﷺ  informed them through the revelation that was sent to him. Imam Ash-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "Whoever says, 'He does not lie,' he says: Indeed, the speech of human beings is not like the speech of Allah. The speech of human beings can be contradicted, don't you see that if a man abandons another man, migration becomes forbidden for him for more than three nights? So if he writes to him or sends him a messenger, and he is able to communicate with him, does this not remove him from the sin of his migration?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ: مَا لَهُ مَالٌ , وَلَهُ عَرَضٌ , أَوْ عَقَارٌ أَوْ حَيَوَانٌ
names.en: Who Swore an Oath: He Has Wealth, Property, or Livestock

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ حَلَفَ: لَيَضْرِبَنَّ عَبْدَهُ مِائَةَ سَوْطٍ , فَجَمَعَهَا فَضَرَبَهُ بِهَا , لَمْ يَحْنَثْ اسْتِدْلَالًا بِقَوْلِهِ ﷻ {وَخُذْ بِيَدِكَ ضِغْثًا فَاضْرِبْ بِهِ وَلَا تَحْنَثْ} [ص: 44]
names.en: Whoever swears to strike his slave with one hundred lashes, and he gathers them and strikes him with them, does not violate the argumentation by the saying of Allah, "And take in your hand a bundle [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath" [Surah Saba: 44]

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى أَنَّهُ يُحَلِّلُ يَمِينَهُ بِأَدْنَى ضَرْبٍ
names.en: What indicates that he can resolve his problem with the least amount of effort?

names.ar: بَابُ الْحَلِفِ عَلَى التَّأْوِيلِ فِيمَا بَيْنَهُ وَبَيْنَ اللهِ تَعَالَى
names.en: Swearing to interpret between oneself and Allah the Almighty

names.ar: بَابُ الْيَمِينِ عَلَى نِيَّةِ الْمُسْتَحْلِفِ فِي الْحُكُومَاتِ
names.en: The oath on the intention of the sworn-in in governments.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ جَعَلَ شَيْئًا مِنْ مَالِهِ صَدَقَةً , أَوْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ أَوْ فِي رِتَاجِ الْكَعْبَةِ عَلَى مَعَانِي الْأَيْمَانِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَالَّذِي يَذْهَبُ إِلَيْهِ عَطَاءٌ أَنَّهُ يُجْزِيهِ مِنْ ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةُ يَمِينٍ , وَمَنْ قَالَ هَذَا الْقَوْلَ , قَالَهُ فِي كُلِّ مَا حَنِثَ فِيهِ , سِوَى عِتْقٍ أَوْ طَلَاقٍ , وَهُوَ مَذْهَبُ عَائِشَةَ ؓ , وَمَذْهَبُ عَدَدٍ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ وَرَضِيَ عَنْهُمْ
names.en: Whoever gives something from his wealth as a charity, or in the way of Allah, or for the maintenance of the Kaaba, according to the meanings of faith, Al-Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "By the One in Whose hand is my soul, it is a reward for him from that as an expiation for an oath. And whoever says this statement, says it in everything he has sworn to, except for freeing a slave or divorce. This is the belief of Aisha and the belief of a number of the Prophet's companions  ﷺ  who were pleased with them.

names.ar:
بَابُ الْخِلَافِ فِي النَّذْرِ الَّذِي يُخْرِجُهُ مَخْرَجَ الْيَمِينِ
قَدْ مَضَى قَوْلُ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ وَمَنْ قَالَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِ مِنَ الصَّحَابَةِ مْ فِي أَنَّهُ يَمِينٌ , يُكَفِّرُهُ مَا يُكَفِّرُ الْيَمِينَ قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: وَقَدْ قَالَ غَيْرُهُ: يَتَصَدَّقُ بِجَمِيعِ مَا يَمْلِكُ , إِلَّا أَنَّهُ قَالَ: وَيَحْبِسُ قَدْرَ مَا يَقُوتُهُ , فَإِذَا أَيْسَرَ , تَصَدَّقَ بِالَّذِي حَبَسَ " , وَذَهَبَ غَيْرُهُ إِلَى أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِثُلُثِ مَالِهِ , وَغَيْرُهُ إِلَى أَنْ يَتَصَدَّقَ بِالزَّكَاةِ ". قَالَ الشَّيْخُ: أَمَّا الْمَذْهَبُ الْأَوَّلُ , فَيُحْكَى عَنْ بَعْضِ الْعِرَاقيِّينَ , وَأَمَّا الثَّانِي فَهُوَ مَذْهَبُ مَالِكٍ وَاحْتَجَّ بَعْضُ مَنْ ذَهَبَ مَذْهَبَهُ بِمَا:
names.en: Differences in the vow that is fulfilled through the right way.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ نَذْرًا فِي مَعْصِيَةِ اللهِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: أَصْلُ مَعْقُولِ قَوْلِ عَطَاءٍ فِي هَذَا: أَنَّهُ ذَهَبَ إِلَى أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ عَلَيْهِ قَضَاءٌ , وَلَا كَفَّارَةٌ , قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَإِنَّمَا أَبْطَلَ اللهُ النَّذْرَ فِي الْبَحِيرَةِ وَالسَّائِبَةِ أَنَّهَا مَعْصِيَةٌ , وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ فِي ذَلِكَ كَفَّارَةً , وَبِذَلِكَ جَاءَتِ السُّنَّةُ
names.en: Whoever makes a vow in disobedience to Allah, Imam Shafi'i said: The valid opinion of 'Ata' regarding this is that it is assumed that there is no obligation or expiation upon the person. Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "Allah only nullifies the vow in regards to the lake and stray animals as they are acts of disobedience, and He does not mention in it any expiation. And that is how the Sunnah came.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ جَعَلَ فِيهِ كَفَّارَةَ يَمِينٍ
names.en: Who has made atonement by oath?

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِيمَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَذْبَحَ ابْنَهُ , أَوْ نَفْسَهُ
names.en: What is mentioned about someone who vowed to slaughter his son, or himself

names.ar: كِتَابُ النُّذُورِ
names.en: Vows

names.ar:
بَابُ الْوَفَاءِ بِالنَّذْرِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ فِي مَدْحِ قَوْمٍ {يُوفُونَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُ مُسْتَطِيرًا} [الإنسان: 7] , وَقَالَ فِي ذَمِّ آخَرِينَ {وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ عَاهَدَ اللهَ لَئِنْ آتَانَا مِنْ فَضْلِهِ لَنَصَّدَّقَنَّ وَلَنَكُونَنَّ مِنَ الصَّالِحِينَ فَلَمَّا آتَاهُمْ مِنْ فَضْلِهِ بَخِلُوا بِهِ وَتَوَلَّوْا وَهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ فَأَعْقَبَهُمْ نِفَاقًا فِي قُلُوبِهِمْ إِلَى يَوْمِ يَلْقَوْنَهُ بِمَا أَخْلَفُوا اللهَ مَا وَعَدُوهُ وَبِمَا كَانُوا يَكْذِبُونَ} [التوبة: 76]
names.en: Fulfilling vows

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُوَفَّى بِهِ مِنَ النُّذُورِ , وَمَا لَا يُوَفَّى
names.en: What is fulfilled from the vows and what is not fulfilled

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُوَفَّى بِهِ مِنْ نُذُورِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ
names.en: What is fulfilled of the pre-Islamic era vows

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُوَفَّى بِهِ مِنْ نَذْرِ مَا يَكُونُ مُبَاحًا , وَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ طَاعَةً
names.en: What is fulfilled from a vow that is permissible, even if it is not an act of obedience.

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ النَّذْرِ
names.en: Dislike of vows

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ تَبَرُّرًا أَنْ يَمْشِيَ إِلَى بَيْتِ اللهِ الْحَرَامِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: لَزِمَهُ أَنْ يَمْشِيَ إِنْ قَدَرَ عَلَى الْمَشْيِ " قَالَ أَصْحَابُنَا: " لِأَنَّ الْمَشْيَ إِلَى مَوْضِعِ الْبِرِّ بِرٌّ " , اسْتِدْلَالًا بِقَوْلِهِ تَعَالَى {يَأْتُوكَ رِجَالًا} [الحج: 27]
names.en:
Whoever makes a vow to walk to the Kaaba 
Imam Al-Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him) said: It is necessary for him to walk if he is able to do so. Our companions said: Because walking to a virtuous location is a virtue. As evidence for this, Allah says: "They come to you on foot" (Surah Al-Hajj, 27)

names.ar: بَابُ رُكُوبِ مَنْ لَمْ يَقْدِرْ عَلَى الْمَشْيِ
names.en: Riding for those who can't walk.

names.ar: بَابُ الْمَشْيِ فِيمَا قَدَرَ عَلَيْهِ , وَالرُّكُوبِ فِيمَا عَجَزَ عَنْهُ
names.en: Walking within one's capacity, and riding in what one is unable to.

names.ar: بَابُ الْهَدْيِ فِيمَا رَكِبَ , وَاخْتِلَافُ الرِّوَايَاتِ فِيهِ
names.en: Guidance on what to ride, and the discrepancies in narrations about it

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ أَمَرَ فِيهِ بِالْإِعَادَةِ وَالْمَشْيِ فِيمَا رَكِبَ , وَالرُّكُوبِ فِيمَا مَشَى , حَتَّى يَأْتِيَ بِهِ كَمَا نَذَرَهُ
names.en: The one who commanded the repetition, walking what he rode, and riding what he walked, until he fulfills it as he vowed.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: يَمْشِي مِنْ مِيقَاتِهِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَكُونَ نَوَى مَكَانًا حَتَّى يَصْدُرَ رُوِيَ ذَلِكَ , عَنْ عَطَاءِ بْنِ أَبِي رَبَاحٍ
names.en: Who said: "He should not leave from his designated place unless he intends a position until that has been reported, by Ata bin Abu Rabah"?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ الْمَشْيَ إِلَى مَسْجِدِ الْمَدِينَةِ أَوْ مَسْجِدِ بَيْتِ الْمَقْدِسِ
names.en: Who vowed to walk to the Mosque of the City or the Mosque of Jerusalem?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ لَمْ يَرَ وُجُوبَهُ بِالنَّذْرِ , أَوْ أَقَامَ الْأَفْضَلَ مِنْ هَذِهِ الْمَسَاجِدِ الثَّلَاثَةِ مَقَامَ مَا هُوَ أَدْنَى مِنْهُ
names.en: Whoever does not consider his vow obligatory, or establishes a place better than these three mosques, has achieved no less.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَنْحَرَ بِمَكَّةَ
names.en: Who vowed to sacrifice in Makkah?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ أَنْ يَنْحَرَ بِغَيْرِهَا لِيَتَصَدَّقَ
names.en: Who vowed to sacrifice without it in order to give charity

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ هَدْيًا لَمْ يُسَمِّهِ
names.en: Whoever makes a vow but does not specify it

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لِلَّهِ عَلَيَّ أَنْ أَصُومَ يَوْمًا سَمَّاهُ , فَوَافَقَ يَوْمَ فِطْرٍ أَوْ أَضْحَى
names.en: Who said, "It is upon Allah to decree that I fast on a day named, so if it coincides with the day of Eid al-Fitr or Eid al-Adha"?

names.ar: بَابُ نَذْرِ الْعُمْرَةِ فِي شَهْرٍ مُسَمًّى فِيهِ , عَنْ جَابِرٍ مِنْ قَوْلِهِ:
بَابُ مَنْ نَذَرَ ضَرْبَ عُنُقِ مُشْرِكٍ إِنْ ظَفِرَ بِهِ , فَأَسْلَمَ
names.en: Who vowed to kill a polytheist upon capture, and then became Muslim

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ مَاتَ وَعَلَيْهِ نَذْرٌ
names.en: Whoever dies and has a vow upon them

names.ar: كِتَابُ آدَابِ الْقَاضِي
names.en: Etiquettes of Judements

names.ar: بَابُ فَضْلِ مَنِ ابْتُلِيَ بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الْأَعْمَالِ , فَقَامَ فِيهِ بِالْقِسْطِ وَقَضَى بِالْحَقِّ
names.en: The Reward for Someone Who Faces a Certain Deed with Justice and Fairness

names.ar: بَابُ فَضْلِ الْمُؤْمِنِ الْقَوِيِّ الَّذِي يَقُومُ بِأَمْرِ النَّاسِ , وَيَصْبِرُ عَلَى أَذَاهُمْ
names.en: The virtue of the strong believer who takes care of people's affairs and endures their harm.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَدَلُّ بِهِ عَلَى أَنَّ الْقَضَاءَ وَسَائِرَ أَعْمَالِ الْوُلَاةِ مِمَّا يَكُونُ أَمْرًا بِمَعْرُوفٍ , أَوْ نَهْيًا عَنْ مُنْكَرٍ مِنْ فُرُوضِ الْكِفَايَاتِ
names.en: What can be inferred from the fact that the courts and other acts of authority are based on what is known as good or forbidding unacceptable practices of collective obligations.

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ الْإِمَارَةِ , وَكَرَاهِيَةِ تَوَلِّي أَعْمَالِهَا لِمَنْ رَأَى مِنْ نَفْسِهِ ضَعْفًا , أَوْ رَأَى فَرْضَهَا عَنْهُ بِغَيْرِهِ سَاقِطًا
names.en: Hatred towards monarchy, and hatred of delegating its affairs to someone who sees himself as weak, or someone who sees it as invalidating him/her without another person.

names.ar: بَابُ كَرَاهِيَةِ طَلَبِ الْإِمَارَةِ وَالْقَضَاءِ وَمَا يُكْرَهُ مِنَ الْحِرْصِ عَلَيْهِمَا وَالتَّسَرُّعِ إِلَيْهِمَا , وَأَنَّهُ إِذَا ابْتُلِيَ بِهِمَا عَنْ غَيْرِ مَسْأَلَةٍ كَانَ الْأَمْرُ أَسْهَلَ , وَإِلَى النَّجَاةِ أَقْرَبَ
names.en: The dislike of seeking authority and judgment, and what is disliked about being eager for them and hastening towards them, and that when one is tested with them without asking for them, the matter becomes easier, and closer to salvation.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْقَاضِي مِنْ أَنْ يَقْضِيَ فِي مَوْضِعٍ بَارِزٍ لِلنَّاسِ , لَا يَكُونُ دُونَهُ حِجَابٌ , وَأَنْ يَكُونَ مُتَوسِّطَ الْمِصْرِ
names.en: What is recommended for a judge to do in a prominent place for people, where there is no barrier, and to be in the middle of the courtroom.

names.ar: بَابُ الرُّخْصَةِ فِي الِاحْتِجَابِ فِي غَيْرِ وَقْتِ الْقَضَاءِ , وَفِي وَقْتِ الْقَضَاءِ إِذَا خَشِيَ الِازْدِحَامَ عَلَيْهِ
names.en: The license for wearing a face veil outside of court sessions, and during court sessions if there is a fear of overcrowding.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْقَاضِي مِنْ أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ قَضَاؤُهُ فِي الْمَسْجِدِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: لِكَثْرَةِ مَنْ يَغْشَاهُ لِغَيْرِ مَا بُنِيَتْ لَهُ الْمَسَاجِدُ
names.en: What is recommended for the judge to not have his court sessions in the mosque? Al-Shafi'i said: May Allah have mercy on him, due to the abundance of distractions that mosques are not meant for.

names.ar:
بَابُ التَّثَبُّتِ فِي الْحُكْمِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا إِنْ جَاءَكُمْ فَاسِقٌ بِنَبَأٍ فَتَبَيَّنُوا أَنْ تُصِيبُوا قَوْمًا بِجَهَالَةٍ فَتُصْبِحُوا عَلَى مَا فَعَلْتُمْ نَادِمِينَ} [الحجرات: 6] وَقَالَ {إِذَا ضَرَبْتُمْ فِي سَبِيلِ اللهِ فَتَبَيَّنُوا} [النساء: 94]
names.en:
Verification in Judgment
Allah, may He be glorified, said: "O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful." [Surah Al-Hujurat: 6] And He said: "When you go forth in the cause of Allah, investigate" [Surah An-Nisa: 94]

names.ar: بَابُ لَا يَقْضِي وَهُوْ غَضْبَانُ
names.en: He does not decide while he is angry

names.ar: بَابُ لَا يَقْضِي الْقَاضِي إِلَّا وَهُوَ شَبْعَانُ رَيَّانُ
names.en: The judge does not pass judgment unless he is full (satisfied) and generous (generous)

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي يَقْضِي فِي حَالِ غَضَبِهِ , فَوَافَقَ الْحَقَّ
names.en: The judge rules in his anger, so he agreed with the truth.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُكْرَهُ لِلْقَاضِي مِنَ الشِّرَاءِ وَالْبَيْعِ وَالنَّظَرِ فِي النَّفَقَةِ عَلَى أَهْلِهِ وَفِي ضَيْعَتِهِ لِئَلَّا يَشْغَلَ فَهْمَهُ
names.en: What is prohibited for the judge from buying and selling, inspecting expenses for his family, and managing his property so as not to distract his understanding

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْقَاضِي وَالْوَالِي مِنْ أَنْ يُوَلِّيَ الشِّرَاءَ لَهُ وَالْبَيْعَ رَجُلًا مَأْمُونًا , غَيْرَ مَشْهُورٍ بِأَنَّهُ يَبِيعُ لَهُ خَوْفَ الْمُحَابَاةِ وَفِي مَعْنَاهُ أَثَرٌ , إِسْنَادُهُ غَيْرُ قَوِيٍّ
names.en: What is preferable for the judge and the governor is to entrust a reliable person with the buying and selling, who is not known to sell to them out of fear of favoritism, and in its meaning, there is an effect. Its credibility is not strong.

names.ar:
بَابُ: الْقَاضِي يَأْتِي الْوَلِيمَةَ إِذَا دُعِيَ لَهَا, وَيَعُودُ الْمَرْضَى, وَيَشْهَدُ الْجَنَائِزَ
قَالَ الْبُخَارِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: قَدْ أَجَابَ عُثْمَانُ عَبْدًا لِلْمُغِيرَةِ بْنِ شُعْبَةَ
names.en: The judge attends the wedding when invited, visits the sick, and witnesses funerals. Al-Bukhari said: Uthman answered a question from al-Mughirah ibn Shu'bah.

names.ar: بَابُ: الْقَاضِي إِذَا بَانَ لَهُ مِنْ أَحَدِ الْخَصْمَيْنِ اللَّدَدُ نَهَاهُ عَنْهُ
names.en: When the judge realizes the seriousness of one of the disputants, he should prevent him from doing so.

names.ar:
بَابُ مُشَاوَرَةِ الْوَالِي وَالْقَاضِي فِي الْأَمْرِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِي الْأَمْرِ} [آل عمران: 159]
names.en:
Consultation between the Governor and the Judge in Matters
Allah, the Exalted, says, "And consult them in the matter." [Al Imran: 159]

names.ar:
بَابُ مَوْضِعِ الْمُشَاوَرَةِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " إِذَا نَزَلَ بِالْحَاكِمِ الْأَمْرُ يَحْتَمِلُ وُجُوهًا , أَوْ مُشْكِلٌ يَنْبَغِي لَهُ أَنْ يُشَاوِرَ
names.en: The Place of Consultation

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ يُشَاوِرُ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: يُشَاوِرُ مَنْ جَمَعَ الْعِلْمَ وَالْأَمَانَةَ
names.en:
Who should seek consultation?" 

Imam Al-Shafi'i (may God have mercy on him) said: "Consultation should be sought from those who combine knowledge and trustworthiness.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا يَقْضِي بِهِ الْقَاضِي وَيُفْتِي بِهِ الْمُفْتِي , فَإِنَّهُ غَيْرُجَائِزٍ لَهُ أَنْ يُقَلِّدَ أَحَدًا مِنْ أَهْلِ دَهْرِهِ , وَلَا أَنْ يَحْكُمَ أَوْ يُفْتِيَ بِالِاسْتِحْسَانِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ {فَإِنْ تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللهِ وَالرَّسُولِ إِنْ كُنْتُمْ تُؤْمِنُونَ بِاللهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الْآخِرِ} [النساء: 59]
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " {فَإِنْ تَنَازَعْتُمْ فِي شَيْءٍ} [النساء: 59] يَعْنِي - وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ: هُمْ وَأُمَرَاؤُهُمُ الَّذِينَ أُمِرُوا بِطَاعَتِهِمْ , {فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى اللهِ وَالرَّسُولِ} [النساء: 59] يَعْنِي - وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ: إِلَى مَا قَالَ اللهُ وَالرَّسُولُ " , وَقَالَ {أَيَحْسَبُ الْإِنْسَانُ أَنْ يُتْرَكَ سُدًى} [القيامة: 36] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: فَلَمْ يَخْتَلِفْ أَهْلُ الْعِلْمِ بِالْقُرْآنِ فِيمَا عَلِمْتُ أَنَّ السُّدَى: الَّذِي لَا يُؤْمَرُ وَلَا يُنْهَى , وَمَنْ أَفْتَى أَوْ حَكَمَ بِمَا لَمْ يُؤْمَرْ بِهِ , فَقَدْ أَجَازَ لِنَفْسِهِ أَنْ يَكُونَ فِي مَعَانِي السُّدَى , قَالَ الشَّيْخُ: " وَرُوِّينَا عَنْ مُجَاهِدٍ فِي تَفْسِيرِ الْآيَتَيْنِ بِنَحْوِ مَا قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ
names.en: What the judge decides and the scholar gives a fatwa on it, it is not permissible for him to imitate anyone from his era, nor to judge or issue a fatwa based on personal opinion. Allah, may He be glorified, says, "But no, by your Lord, they will not [truly] believe until they make you, [O Muhammad], judge concerning that over which they dispute among themselves and then find within themselves no discomfort from what you have judged and submit in [full, willing] submission." [Nisa: 59]. Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "And [if] they dispute over something" [Nisa: 59] means - and Allah knows best - them and their leaders who have been commanded to obey them. "[Then] return it to Allah and the Messenger" [Nisa: 59] means - and Allah knows best - to what Allah and the Messenger have said." And He said, "Does man think that he will be left neglected?" [Qiyamah: 36]. Imam Shafi'i said: The people of knowledge have not disagreed in the Qur'an about what I know, that neglect is that which is not commanded or forbidden. And whoever gives a fatwa or judges based on what he is not commanded to do, he has allowed himself to be in the meanings of neglect. The sheikh said: "And it has been narrated from Mujahid in the interpretation of these two verses in a way similar to what Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said.

names.ar: بَابُ إِثْمِ مَنْ أَفْتَى , أَوْ قَضَى بِالْجَهْلِ
names.en: The sin of giving religious rulings or making judgments out of ignorance

names.ar: بَابُ: لَا يُوَلِّي الْوَالِي امْرَأَةً , وَلَا فَاسِقًا , وَلَا جَاهِلًا أَمْرَ الْقَضَاءِ
names.en: A governor should not appoint a woman, a corrupt person, or an ignorant person to rule the judiciary

names.ar:
بَابُ اجْتِهَادِ الْحَاكِمِ فِيمَا يَسُوغُ فِيهِ الِاجْتِهَادُ وَهُوَ مِنْ أَهْلِ الِاجْتِهَادِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَدَاوُدَ وَسُلَيْمَانَ إِذْ يَحْكُمَانِ فِي الْحَرْثِ إِذْ نَفَشَتْ فِيهِ غَنَمُ الْقَوْمِ وَكُنَّا لِحُكْمِهِمْ شَاهِدِينَ} {فَفَهَّمْنَاهَا سُلَيْمَانَ وَكُلًّا آتَيْنَا حُكْمًا وَعِلْمًا} [الأنبياء: 79]
names.en: The Exertion of the Ruler in Matters that Allow for Exertion and He is Among the People of Exertion. Allah, Most High, says: "And Daoud and Sulayman, when they were ruling over the tillage, and We were Witness to their ruling" "So We made Sulayman to understand it, and to each We gave Wisdom and Judgment" [Al-Anbiya:79]

names.ar: بَابُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ , ثُمَّ رَأَى أَنَّ اجْتِهَادَهُ خَالَفَ نَصًّا أَوْ إجْمَاعًا أَوْ مَا فِي مَعْنَاهُ , رَدَّهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ , وَعَلَى غَيْرِهِ
names.en: Whoever strives and then realizes that his effort contradicts a text, consensus, or its intended meaning, he should retract it both for himself and for others.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنِ اجْتَهَدَ مِنَ الْحُكَّامِ , ثُمَّ تَغَيَّرَ اجْتِهَادُهُ , أَوِ اجْتِهَادُ غَيْرِهِ فِيمَا يَسُوغُ فِيهِ الِاجْتِهَادُ , لَمْ يَرُدَّ مَا قَضَى بِهِ اسْتِدْلَالًا بِمَا مَضَى فِي خَطَأِ الْقِبْلَةِ فِي كِتَابِ الصَّلَاةِ
names.en: Anyone who exerted effort from the judges, then their exertion changed, or the exertion of others in what is permissible to exert in it, he does not invalidate what was ruled by using evidence from what was previously mentioned in the book of prayer concerning the mistake of the qibla

names.ar: بَابُ وَعْظِ الْقَاضِي الشُّهُودَ , وَتَخْوِيفِهِمْ وَتَعْرِيفِهِمْ عِنْدَ الرِّيبَةِ , بِمَا فِي شَهَادَةِ الزُّورِ مِنْ كَبِيرِ الْإِثْمِ , وَعَظِيمِ الْوِزْرِ
names.en: The Preaching of the Judge to the Witnesses, and Intimidating and Informing them about False Testimony, and the Magnitude of the Sin and the Serious Consequences

names.ar: بَابُ مَسْأَلَةِ الْقَاضِي عَنْ أَحْوَالِ الشُّهُودِ فَفِي النَّاسِ بَرٌّ وَفَاجِرٌ وَأَمِينٌ وَخَائِنٌ , وَقَدْ قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالَى: {مِمَّنْ تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ} [البقرة: 282]
names.en: The Problem of the Judge Regarding the Status of Witnesses: Among People There Are the Righteous and the Wicked, the Trustworthy and the Treacherous, and Allah Almighty has said: "Choose from among the witnesses whom you approve." [Al-Baqarah: 282]

names.ar: بَابُ اعْتِمَادِ الْقَاضِي عَلَى تَزْكِيَةِ الْمُزَكِّينَ وَجَرْحِهِمْ
names.en: The reliance of the judge on the endorsement and criticism of witnesses

names.ar: بَابُ عَدَدِ الْمُزَكِّينَ
names.en: The number of winners

names.ar:
بَابُ: لَا يُقْبَلُ الْجَرْحَ فِيمَنْ ثَبَتَتْ عَدَالَتُهُ إِلَّا بِأَنْ يَقِفَهُ عَلَى مَا يَجْرَحُهُ بِهِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: لِأَنَّ النَّاسَ يَخْتَلِفُونَ وَيَتبَايَنُونَ فِي الْأَهْوَاءِ
names.en: An injury is not accepted in someone whose justice has been established except by showing him what hurts him with it." Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "Because people differ and diverge in their desires

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَقُولُ فِي لَفْظِ التَّعْدِيلِ
names.en: What does he say about the term "ta'dil"?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنَ يُرْجَعُ إِلَيْهِ فِي السُّؤَالِ , يَجِبُ أَنْ تَكُونَ مَعْرِفَتُهُ بَاطِنَةً مُتَقَادِمَةً
names.en: Who is being referred to in the question, their knowledge must be advanced.

names.ar: بَابُ اتِّخَاذِ الْكُتَّابِ
names.en: Writing

names.ar: بَابُ: لَا يَتَّخِذُ كَاتِبًا لِأُمُورِ النَّاسِ حَتَّى يَجْمَعَ أَنْ يَكُونَ عَدْلًا عَاقِلًا فَقِيهًا بَعِيدًا مِنَ الطَّمَعِ
names.en: A writer should not be chosen for people's affairs until he possesses justice, wisdom, and understanding, away from greed.

names.ar:
بَابُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْقَاضِي وَلَا لِلْوَالِي أَنْ يَتَّخِذَ كَاتِبًا ذِمِّيًّا وَلَا يَضَعُ الذِّمِّيَّ فِي مَوْضِعٍ يَتَفَضَّلُ فِيهِ مُسْلِمًا
رُوِّينَا فِي كِتَابِ السِّيَرِ عَنْ عُرْوَةَ عَنْ عَائِشَةَ، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: " لَنْ أَسْتَعِينَ بِمُشْرِكٍ " وَاللَّفْظُ عَامٌّ
names.en: It is not appropriate for a judge or a governor to appoint a non-Muslim as a scribe, nor should a Muslim put a non-Muslim in a position of authority. There is a narration in the book Al-Siyar that mentions a statement from Aisha, narrated by Urwa, from the Prophet  ﷺ : "I will not seek assistance from a polytheist." And the wording is general.

names.ar: بَابُ كِتَابِ الْقَاضِي إِلَى الْقَاضِي , وَالْقَاضِي إِلَى الْأَمِيرِ , وَالْأَمِيرِ إِلَى الْقَاضِي
names.en: The Book of the Judge to the Judge, and the Judge to the Prince, and the Prince to the Judge.

names.ar: بَابُ خَتْمِ الْكِتَابِ
names.en: The completion of the book

names.ar:
بَابُ الِاحْتِيَاطِ فِي قِرَاءَةِ الْكِتَابِ وَالْإِشْهَادِ عَلَيْهِ وَخَتْمِهِ لِئَلَّا يُزَوَّرَ عَلَيْهِ
وَقَدْ قَالَ مُطَرِّفُ بْنُ عَبْدِ اللهِ: " احْتَرِسُوا مِنَ النَّاسِ بِسُوءِ الظَّنِّ "
names.en:
Precautions in reading, testifying, and sealing the book, so that it is not forged.
And Muttarif ibn Abdullah said: "Beware of people with ill intentions.

names.ar: بَابُ الرَّجُلِ يَبْدَأُ بِنَفْسِهِ فِي الْكِتَابِ
names.en: The man starts with himself in the book.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ بَدَأَ بِالْمَكْتُوبِ إِلَيْهِ , وَكَيْفَ يَكْتُبُ
names.en: Who started with what is written to him, and how does he write?

names.ar: بَابٌ: كَيْفَ يُكْتَبُ إِلَى أَهْلِ الْكِتَابِ
names.en: How to write to the people of the book

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي يَحْكُمُ بِشَيْءٍ فَيَكْتُبُ لِلْمَحْكُومِ لَهُ بِمَسْأَلَتِهِ كِتَابًا
names.en: The judge rules on something, so he writes a book for the defendant in his case.

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي يَحْكُمُ بِشَيْءٍ , فَيَشْهَدُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ بِمَا حَكَمَ بِهِ
names.en: The judge pronounces something, then testifies to himself about what he has ruled.

names.ar: بَابُ الْقِسْمَةِ
names.en: Division

names.ar:
بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي أَجْرِ الْقَسَّامِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: يَنْبَغِي أَنْ يُعْطَى أَجْرُ الْقَسَّامِ مِنْ بَيْتِ الْمَالِ , لِأَنَّ الْقَسَّامَ حَكَّامٌ.
قَالَ الشَّيْخُ الْفَقِيهُ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " قَدْ رُوِّينَا فِي سَهْمِ الْمُصَالِحِ سَهْمُ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ كَانَ لِنَوَائِبِهِ وَنَوَائِبِ النَّاسِ
names.en:
Translation: "What is mentioned about the reward of the Qasam?"
Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "The reward of the Qasam should be given from the treasury, because the Qasam are rulers."
The scholar and jurist, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "It has been narrated to us regarding the share of interests that the Prophet,  ﷺ , had a share in it for his needs and the needs of the people.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا لَا يَحْتَمِلُ الْقِسْمَةَ
names.en: What cannot be divided

names.ar: بَابُ إِنْصَافِ الْقَاضِي فِي الْحُكْمِ , وَمَا يَجِبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنَ الْعَدْلِ فِيهِ , لِمَا فِي الظُّلْمِ مِنْ عَظِيمِ الْوِزْرِ , وَكَبِيرِ الْإِثْمِ
names.en: The judge's fairness in judgment, and what he is obligated to do in terms of justice in it, because of the great burden and the severity of the sin in wrongdoing.

names.ar: بَابُ إِنْصَافِ الْخَصْمَيْنِ فِي الْمَدْخَلِ عَلَيْهِ , وَالِاسْتِمَاعِ مِنْهُمَا , وَالْإِنْصَافِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَتَّى تَنْفَدَ حُجَّتُهُ , وَحُسْنِ الْإِقْبَالِ عَلَيْهِمَا
names.en: Fair treatment of both parties in the entrance to it, and listening to them, and fairness to each one of them until their argument is exhausted, and good reception of them.

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي لَا يَنْهَرُ الْخَصْمَيْنِ
names.en: The judge does not admonish the disputants.

names.ar: بَابٌ: الْقَاضِي يَكُفُّ كُلَّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَ الْخَصْمَيْنِ عَنْ عِرْضِ صَاحِبِهِ
names.en: The judge protects each one of the disputants from the presentation of their opponent.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا يَقُولُ الْقَاضِي إِذَا جَلَسَ الْخَصْمَانِ بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ
names.en: What does the judge say when the litigants sit before him?

names.ar:
بَابُ لَا يَنْبَغِي لِلْقَاضِي أَنْ يُضِيفَ الْخَصْمَ إِلَّا وَخَصْمُهُ مَعَهُ
لِمَا مَضَى مِنَ الْأَمْرِ بِالتَّسْوِيَةِ بَيْنَهُمَا وَرُوِيَ فِيهِ أَثَرٌ بِإِسْنَادٍ فِيهِ ضَعْفٌ
names.en: It is not permissible for a judge to summon the opponent except when his opponent is present in order to settle the matter between them, and it has been narrated that there is a weakness in the chain of narration.

names.ar: بَابُ لَا يَقْبَلُ مِنْهُ هَدِيَّةً
names.en: He does not accept a gift from him.

names.ar: بَابُ التَّشْدِيدِ فِي أَخْذِ الرِّشْوَةِ , وَفِي إِعْطَائِهَا عَلَى إِبْطَالِ حَقٍّ
names.en: The intensification of taking bribes and giving them to invalidate a right.

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ أَعْطَاهَا لِيَدْفَعَ بِهَا عَنْ نَفْسِهِ، أَوْ مَالِهِ ظُلْمًا , أَوْ يَأْخُذَ بِهَا حَقًّا
names.en: Who gave it to him to use it against himself, or his money unjustly, or to take his rights with it

names.ar:
بَابٌ: الْقَاضِي يُقَدِّمُ النَّاسَ الْأَوَّلَ فَالْأَوَّلَ, فَلِلْأَوَّلِ حَقُّ السَّبْقِ, وَالسَّبْقُ أَصْلٌ فِي الشَّرِيعَةِ
وَرُوِّينَا عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ؓ , عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: " مِنًى مُنَاخُ مَنْ سَبَقَ " , وَعَنْ أَسْمَرَ بْنِ مُضَرِّسٍ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ: " مَنْ سُبِقَ إِلَى مَا لَمْ يَسْبِقْهُ إِلَيْهِ مُسْلِمٌ فَهُوَ لَهُ " , يُرِيدُ بِهِ إِحْيَاءَ الْمَوَاتِ
names.en: The judge gives precedence to people, so the first has the right of priority, and priority is a basis in Sharia law. And we have been narrated from Aisha, from the Prophet  ﷺ : 'Whoever comes first to Mina has a right.' And from Asmar ibn Mudarris, from the Prophet  ﷺ : 'Whoever reaches something before anyone else, then it belongs to him.' He meant by this reviving the dead.

names.ar:
بَابُ مَنْ دُعِيَ إِلَى حُكْمِ حَاكِمٍ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَإِذَا دُعُوا إِلَى اللهِ وَرَسُولِهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِذَا فَرِيقٌ مِنْهُمْ مُعْرِضُونَ} [النور: 48]
names.en:
Who was called to judge a ruler?
God, may His praise be exalted, said: "And when they are called to Allah and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside." [Quran 24:48]

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي لَا يَقْبَلُ شَهَادَةَ الشَّاهِدِ إِلَّا بِمَحْضَرٍ مِنَ الْخَصْمِ الْمَشْهُودِ عَلَيْهِ , وَلَا يَقْضِي عَلَى الْغَائِبِ
names.en: The judge does not accept the testimony of the witness except with a statement from the opposing party who is witnessed against, and does not rule in absentia.

names.ar: بَابٌ: مَنْ أَجَازَ الْقَضَاءَ عَلَى الْغَائِبِ
names.en: Who authorized the court ruling on the absent one?

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا يَفْعَلُ بِشَاهِدِ الزُّورِ
names.en: What does the witness of falsehood do?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لِلْقَاضِي أَنْ يَقْضِيَ بِعِلْمِهِ
names.en: Who said: The judge must judge based on his knowledge?

names.ar: بَابُ مَنْ قَالَ: لَيْسَ لِلْقَاضِي أَنْ يَقْضِيَ بِعِلْمِهِ
names.en: Who said: "It is not for the judge to rule by his knowledge.

names.ar: بَابُ الْقَاضِي لَا يَحْكُمُ لِنَفْسِهِ
names.en: The judge does not rule for himself.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي التَّحْكِيمِ
names.en: What is included in the arbitration?

names.ar: كِتَابُ الشَّهَادَاتِ
names.en: Witnesses

names.ar: بَابُ الْأَمْرِ بِالْإِشْهَادِ
names.en: Ordering Testimony in English

names.ar: بَابُ الِاخْتِيَارِ فِي الْإِشْهَادِ
names.en: The Selection in Testimony

names.ar:
بَابُ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي الزِّنَا
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَاللَّاتِي يَأْتِينَ الْفَاحِشَةَ مِنْ نِسَائِكُمْ فَاسْتَشْهِدُوا عَلَيْهِنَّ أَرْبَعَةً مِنْكُمْ} [النساء: 15] , وَقَالَ: {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً} [النور: 4]
names.en: The Testimony in Adultery: God Almighty says, "And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes" [Surah An-Nur: 4].

names.ar:
بَابُ الشَّهَادَةِ فِي الطَّلَاقِ, وَالرَّجْعَةِ وَمَا فِي مَعْنَاهُمَا مِنَ النِّكَاحِ وَالْقِصَاصِ وَالْحُدُودِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {فَإِذَا بَلَغْنَ أَجَلَهُنَّ فَأَمْسِكُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ أَوْ فَارِقُوهُنَّ بِمَعْرُوفٍ وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ} [الطلاق: 2]
names.en: The attestation of divorce, revocability, and everything pertaining to them from marriage, retribution, and prescribed punishments. Allah, may He be praised, said: "And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you." [Quran 65:2]

names.ar:
بَابُ: الشَّهَادَةُ فِي الدَّيْنِ وَمَا فِي مَعْنَاهُ مِمَّا يَكُونُ مَالًا , أَوْ يُقْصَدُ بِهِ الْمَالُ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {إِذَا تَدَايَنْتُمْ بِدَيْنٍ إِلَى أَجَلٍ مُسَمًّى فَاكْتُبُوهُ} [البقرة: 282] , وَقَالَ فِي سِيَاقِهَا: {وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ فَإِنْ لَمْ يَكُونَا رَجُلَيْنِ فَرَجُلٌ وَامْرَأَتَانِ مِمَّنْ تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ أَنْ تَضِلَّ إِحْدَاهُمَا فَتُذَكِّرَ إِحْدَاهُمَا الْأُخْرَى} [البقرة: 282]
names.en: The testimony in religion and what it includes of wealth or what it refers to as wealth. Allah, the Exalted, says: "When you contract a debt for a specified term, write it down." [Quran 2:282] And He says in the context of it: "And call to witness two witnesses from among your men. And if there are not two men [available], then a man and two women from those whom you accept as witnesses - so that if one of the women errs, then the other can remind her." [Quran 2:282]

names.ar: بَابُ: لَا يُحِيلُ حُكْمُ الْقَاضِي عَلَى الْمَقْضِيِّ لَهُ , وَالْمَقْضِيِّ عَلَيْهِ , وَلَا يَجْعَلُ الْحَلَالَ عَلَى وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَرَامًا , وَلَا الْحَرَامَ عَلَى وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا حَلَالًا
names.en: The judge's ruling does not affect the resolved and the resolved upon, and does not make the permissible unlawful for one of them, nor the unlawful permissible for one of them.

names.ar: بَابُ: شَهَادَةُ النِّسَاءِ لَا رَجُلَ مَعَهُنَّ فِي الْوِلَادَةِ , وَعُيُوبُ النِّسَاءِ
names.en: The testimony of women without a man present during childbirth and the flaws of women.

names.ar: بَابُ مَا جَاءَ فِي عَدَدِهِنَّ
names.en: What was mentioned in their number?

names.ar:
بَابُ شَهَادَةِ الْقَاذِفِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَالَّذِينَ يَرْمُونَ الْمُحْصَنَاتِ ثُمَّ لَمْ يَأْتُوا بِأَرْبَعَةِ شُهَدَاءَ فَاجْلِدُوهُمْ ثَمَانِينَ جَلْدَةً وَلَا تَقْبَلُوا لَهُمْ شَهَادَةً أَبَدًا وَأُولَئِكَ هُمُ الْفَاسِقُونَ} [النور: 4] {إِلَّا الَّذِينَ تَابُوا مِنْ بَعْدِ ذَلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا فَإِنَّ اللهَ غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ} [آل عمران: 89] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: وَالثُّنْيَا فِي سِيَاقِ الْكَلَامِ عَلَى أَوَّلِ الْكَلَامِ وَآخِرِهِ فِي جَمِيعِ مَا ذَهَبَ إِلَيْهِ أَهْلُ الْفِقْهِ , إِلَّا أَنْ يُفَرِّقَ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ خَبَرٌ , -[256]- قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَإِنَّ فِيهِ لَحَدِيثًا ".
names.en: The Testimony of the Accuser

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: لَا تُقْبَلُ شَهَادَتُهُ
names.en: Who said: "His testimony is not accepted"?

names.ar:
بَابُ التَّحَفُّظِ فِي الشَّهَادَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ بِهَا
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَلَا تَقْفُ مَا لَيْسَ لَكَ بِهِ عِلْمٌ إِنَّ السَّمْعَ وَالْبَصَرَ وَالْفُؤَادَ كُلُّ أُولَئِكَ كَانَ عَنْهُ مَسْئُولًا} وَقَالَ: {إِلَّا مَنْ شَهِدَ بِالْحَقِّ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ} [الزخرف: 86] وَقَالَ فِي قِصَّةِ إِخْوَةِ يُوسُفَ عَلَيْهِمُ الصَّلَاةُ وَالسَّلَامُ: {وَمَا شَهِدْنَا إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمْنَا وَمَا كُنَّا لِلْغَيْبِ حَافِظِينَ} [يوسف: 81] , قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَلَا يَسَعُ شَاهِدًا أَنْ يَشْهَدَ إِلَّا بِمَا عَلِمَ "
names.en:
Cautiousness in testimony and knowledge of it.
Allah, may He be glorified, said: "And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned." And He said: "Except for those who testify to the truth [can be trusted], while knowing." [Az-Zukhruf: 86] And He said in the story of the brothers of Joseph, peace be upon them: "And we did not testify except to what we knew. And we were not of the absent." [Yusuf: 81] Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "A witness is not allowed to testify except to what he knows.

names.ar:
بَابُ وُجُوهِ الْعِلْمِ بِالشَّهَادَةِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: مِنْهَا: مَا عَايَنَهُ الشَّاهِدُ , فَيَشْهَدُ بِالْمُعَايَنَةِ. قَالَ الشَّيْخُ: وَهِيَ الْأَفْعَالُ الَّتِي تُعَايِنُهَا فَتَشَهَدُ عَلَيْهَا بِالْمُعَايَنَةِ
names.en:
The faces of knowledge with witnessing
Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: Among them is what the witness sees and testifies based on observation. The scholar said: And it is the actions that are witnessed by observing them, so one testifies based on observation.

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا يَجِبُ عَلَى الْمَرْءِ مِنَ الْقِيَامِ بِشَهَادَتِهِ إِذَا شَهِدَ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ لِلَّهِ شُهَدَاءَ بِالْقِسْطِ وَلَا يَجْرِمَنَّكُمْ شَنَآنُ قَوْمٍ عَلَى أَلَّا تَعْدِلُوا اعْدِلُوا هُوَ أَقْرَبُ لِلتَّقْوَى} [المائدة: 8] وَقَالَ: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا كُونُوا قَوَّامِينَ بِالْقِسْطِ شُهَدَاءَ لِلَّهِ وَلَوْ عَلَى أَنْفُسِكُمْ أَوِ الْوَالِدَيْنِ وَالْأَقْرَبِينَ إِنْ يَكُنْ غَنِيًّا أَوْ فَقِيرًا فَاللهُ أَوْلَى بِهِمَا فَلَا تَتَّبِعُوا الْهَوَى} [النساء: 135] الْآيَةَ , وَقَالَ: {وَلَا تَكْتُمُوا الشَّهَادَةَ وَمَنْ يَكْتُمْهَا فَإِنَّهُ آثِمٌ قَلْبُهُ وَاللهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ عَلِيمٌ} [البقرة: 283]، قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " الَّذِي أَحْفَظُ عَنْ كُلِّ مَنْ سَمِعْتُ مِنْهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْعِلْمِ فِي هَذِهِ -[267]- الْآيَةِ أَنَّهُ فِي الشَّاهِدِ قَدْ لَزِمَتْهُ الشَّهَادَةُ ".
names.en: What a person must do when they bear witness

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي خَيْرِ الشُّهَدَاءِ
names.en: What came in the best of the martyrs?

names.ar: بَابُ: كَرَاهِيَةُ التَّسَارُعِ إِلَى الشَّهَادَةِ وَصَاحِبُهَا بِهَا عَالِمٌ حَتَّى يَسْتَشْهِدَهُ
names.en: The Detestation of hastening towards martyrdom and its claimant with a knowledgeable witness until he testifies

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا عَلَى مَنْ دُعِيَ لِيَشْهَدَ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَلَا يَأْبَ الشُّهَدَاءُ إِذَا مَا دُعُوا} [البقرة: 282].
names.en: What is the duty of those who are called to testify? God, may His praises be exalted, said: "And let not the witnesses refuse when they are called." [Surah Al-Baqarah: 282]

names.ar: بَابُ: {وَلَا يُضَارَّ كَاتِبٌ وَلَا شَهِيدٌ} [البقرة: 282]
names.en: And neither a scribe nor a witness is harmed." [Al-Baqarah: 282]

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَنْ رَدَّ شَهَادَةَ الْعَبِيدِ وَمَنْ قَبِلَهَا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ} [البقرة: 282] قَالَ: وَرِجَالُنَا أَحْرَارُنَا , لَا مَمَالِيكُنَا الَّذِينَ يَغْلِبُهُمْ مَنْ يَمْلِكُهُمْ عَلَى كَثِيرٍ مِنْ أُمُورِهِمْ , فَلَا يَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ مَمْلُوكٍ فِي شَيْءٍ وَإِنْ قَلَّ "
names.en: Who Refuted the Testimony of Slaves and who Accepted it

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَنْ رَدَّ شَهَادَةَ الصِّبْيَانِ وَمَنْ قَبِلَهَا فِي الْجِرَاحِ مَا لَمْ يَتَفَرَّقُوا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: قَوْلُ اللهِ ﷻ: {مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ} [البقرة: 282] يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنْ لَا تَجُوزَ شَهَادَةُ الصِّبْيَانِ وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ فِي شَيْءٍ , ولِأَنَّهُ إِنَّمَا خُوطِبَ بِالْفَرَائِضِ الْبَالِغُونَ دُونَ مَنْ لَمْ يَبْلُغْ , وَلِأَنَّهُمْ لَيْسُوا مِمَّنْ يُرْضَى مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ , وَإِنَّمَا أَمَرَنَا اللهُ أَنْ نَقْبَلَ شَهَادَةَ مَنْ نَرْضَى " قَالَ الشَّيْخُ: " وَقَدْ رُوِّينَا، عَنِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ أَنَّهُ رُفِعَ الْقَلَمُ عَنْ ثَلَاثَةٍ: عَنِ الصَّبِيِّ حَتَّى يَحْتَلِمَ , وَعَنِ الْمَعْتُوهِ حَتَّى يُفِيقَ , وَعَنِ النَّائِمِ حَتَّى يَسْتَيْقِظَ , قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: فَإِنْ قَالَ قَائِلٌ: أَجَازَهَا ابْنُ الزُّبَيْرِ , فَابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ رَدَّهَا ".
names.en:
Who rejects the testimony of children and who accepts it in cases of injuries as long as they have not reached puberty?
Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: The saying of Allah: "Among your men" [Al-Baqarah: 282] indicates that the testimony of children is not valid, and Allah knows best. It is because the verse was specifically addressing adults and not those who have not reached puberty. And because they are not among those whose testimony is accepted, as Allah has commanded us to accept the testimony of those whom we are pleased with." The Sheikh said: "And it has been narrated to us from the Prophet  ﷺ  that the pen is lifted from three: from the child until he reaches puberty, from the insane person until he regains sanity, and from the sleeping person until he wakes up." Al-Shafi'i said: "If someone says that Ibn Zubayr permitted it, then Ibn Abbas rejected it.

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَنْ رَدَّ شَهَادَةَ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ} [الطلاق: 2] وَقَالَ: {وَاسْتَشْهِدُوا شَهِيدَيْنِ مِنْ رِجَالِكُمْ} [البقرة: 282] وَقَالَ: {مِمَّنْ تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ} [البقرة: 282] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " فَفِي هَاتَيْنِ الْآيَتَيْنِ وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ دَلَالَةٌ عَلَى أَنَّ اللهَ تَعَالَى إِنَّمَا عَنَى الْمُسْلِمِينَ دُونَ غَيْرِهِمْ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَنَّ رِجَالَنَا وَمَنْ نَرْضَى مِنْ أَهْلِ دِينِنَا لَا الْمُشْرِكُونَ لَقَطَعَ اللهُ تَعَالَى الْوَلَايَةَ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَهُمْ بِالدِّينِ. -[274]- قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: " وَكَيْفَ يَجُوزُ أَنْ تُرَدَّ شَهَادَةُ مُسْلِمٍ بِأَنْ نَعْرِفَهُ يَكْذِبُ عَلَى بَعْضِ الْآدَمَيِّينَ وَنُجِيزَ شَهَادَةَ ذَمِّيٍّ وَهُوَ يَكْذِبُ عَلَى اللهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى؟ " قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: وَقَدْ أَخْبَرَنَا اللهُ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَدْ بَدَّلُوا كِتَابَ اللهِ , وَكَتَبُوا الْكِتَابَ بِأَيْدِيهِمْ , وَقَالُوا: {هَذَا مِنْ عِنْدِ اللهِ لِيَشْتَرُوا بِهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا} [البقرة: 79] "
names.en: Who Rejects the Testimony of People of Dhimma

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللهِ ﷻ: {يَا أَيُّهَا الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا شَهَادَةُ بَيْنِكُمْ إِذَا حَضَرَ أَحَدَكُمُ الْمَوْتُ حِينَ الْوَصِيَّةِ اثْنَانِ ذَوَا عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ أَوْ آخَرَانِ مِنْ غَيْرِكُمْ} [المائدة: 106]
20620 - أَخْبَرَنَا أَبُو سَعِيدِ بْنُ أَبِي عَمْرٍو , ثنا أَبُو الْعَبَّاسِ الْأَصَمُّ , أَنْبَأَ الرَّبِيعُ قَالَ: قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " فِي هَذِهِ الْآيَةِ وَاللهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَعْنَى مَا أَرَادَ مِنْ هَذَا , وَقَدْ سَمِعْتُ مَنْ يَتَأَوَّلُ هَذِهِ الْآيَةَ عَلَى: مِنْ غَيْرِ قَبِيلِكُمْ مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ , وَيَحْتَجُّ فِيهَا بِقَوْلِ اللهِ تَبَارَكَ وَتَعَالَى: {تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنْ بَعْدِ الصَّلَاةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللهِ إِنِ ارْتَبْتُمْ لَا نَشْتَرِي بِهِ ثَمَنًا} [المائدة: 106] وَالصَّلَاةُ الْمُوَقَّتَةُ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ , وَبِقَولِ اللهِ: {وَلَوْ كَانَ ذَا قُرْبَى} [المائدة: 106] وَإِنَّمَا الْقَرَابَةُ -[276]- بَيْنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ الَّذِينَ كَانُوا مَعَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ مِنَ الْعَرَبِ , أَوْ بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِ الْأَوْثَانِ , لَا بَيْنَهُمْ وَبَيْنَ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ , وَيَقُولُ اللهُ: {وَلَا نَكْتُمُ شَهَادَةَ اللهِ إِنَّا إِذًا لِمَنَ الْآثِمِينَ} [المائدة: 106] وَإِنَّمَا يَتَأَثَّمُ مِنْ كِتْمَانِ الشَّهَادَةِ لِلْمُسْلِمِينَ الْمُسْلِمُونَ , لَا أَهْلُ الذِّمَّةِ ".
names.en:
What is mentioned in the saying of Allah: "O you who have believed, when death approaches one of you, while he is leaving a will, there should be two just men from among you or two others from outside you as witnesses" [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 106]
20620 - Abu Sa'id bin Abi 'Amr informed us, Abu Al-'Abbas Al-Asamm narrated to us, Rabee'ah reported, he said: Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "In this verse, only Allah knows the intended meaning. I have heard some people interpret this verse as referring to non-Arabs among the Muslims and use as evidence the statement of Allah the Exalted: 'You restrain them from [emigrating for] Jihad in Allah's cause, and] they take oath before Allah that they will not sell their articles for a price' [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 106]. And the prayer that is specified for the Muslims and the saying of Allah: 'And if it was [from] near relatives' [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 106]. And indeed, the relatives are only among the Muslims who were with the Prophet ﷺ from the Arabs, or between them and the idolaters, not between them and the people of the covenant. And Allah says: 'And do not conceal testimony, for whoever conceals it - his heart is indeed sinful' [Surah Al-Ma'idah: 106]. And the sin is incurred by concealing testimony among the Muslim Muslims, not the people of the covenant.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ أَجَازَ شَهَادَةَ أَهْلِ الذِّمَّةِ عَلَى الْوَصِيَّةِ فِي السَّفَرِ عِنْدَ عَدَمِ مَنْ شَهِدَ عَلَيْهَا مِنَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
names.en: Who is authorized to approve the testimony of the people of the covenant on the will in travel when none of the Muslims have witnessed it?

names.ar:
بَابُ: لَا يَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ غَيْرِ عَدْلٍ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {وَأَشْهِدُوا ذَوَيْ عَدْلٍ مِنْكُمْ} [الطلاق: 2] وَقَالَ: {مِمَّنْ تَرْضَوْنَ مِنَ الشُّهَدَاءِ} [البقرة: 282] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَإِنَّا لَا نَرْضَى أَهْلَ الْفِسْقِ مِنَّا , وَإِنَّ الرِّضَا إِنَّمَا يَقَعُ عَلَى الْعُدُولِ مِنَّا ".
names.en:
It is not permissible to testify except for an upright person. 
Allah, may He be glorified, said: "And bring to witness two witnesses from among your men" (Quran 65:2). He also said: "Write them down as one from amongst your witnesses" (Quran 2:282). Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "We do not accept the testimony of immoral people among us, and acceptance applies only to the upright among us.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ تَحَمَّلَ الشَّهَادَةَ وَهُوَ كَافِرٌ , أَوْ صَبِيٌّ أَوْ عَبْدٌ , ثُمَّ أَسْلَمَ الْكَافِرُ , وَبَلَغَ الصَّبِيُّ , وَعَتَقَ الْعَبْدُ , فَقَامُوا بِشَهَادَتِهِمْ
names.en: Who bears witness while being a disbeliever, or a child, or a slave, then the disbeliever converts to Islam, and the child reaches puberty, and the slave is freed, so they testified.

names.ar: بَابُ: الْقَضَاءُ بِالْيَمِينِ مَعَ الشَّاهِدِ
names.en: Taking an oath with a witness

names.ar: بَابُ: تَأْكِيدُ الْيَمِينِ بِالْمَكَانِ
names.en: Confirmation of right place

names.ar:
بَابُ: تَأْكِيدُ الْيَمِينِ بِالزَّمَانِ , وَالْحَلِفِ عَلَى الْمُصْحَفِ
قَالَ اللهُ جَلَّ ثَنَاؤُهُ: {تَحْبِسُونَهُمَا مِنْ بَعْدِ الصَّلَاةِ فَيُقْسِمَانِ بِاللهِ} [المائدة: 106] قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " وَقَالَ الْمُفَسِّرُونَ: صَلَاةُ الْعَصْرِ. قَالَ الشَّيْخُ:
names.en:
Confirmation of Oath by Time, and Swearing by the Quran
God Almighty said: "But you detain them from prayer, so they pass on and swear by Allah." (Al-Ma'idah: 106) Al-Shafi'i, may God have mercy on him, said: "And the interpreters said: the evening prayer." The scholar said:

names.ar: بَابُ: التَّشْدِيدُ فِي الْيَمِينِ الْفَاجِرَةِ , وَمَا يُسْتَحَبُّ لِلْإِمَامِ مِنَ الْوَعْظِ فِيهَا
names.en: Intensifying in the Wicked Righteousness and What is Recommended for the Imam to Preach in it

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الِافْتِدَاءَ عَنِ الْيَمِينِ , وَمَنْ رَخَّصَ فِيهَا إِذَا كَانَ مُحِقًّا
names.en: What is mentioned in the concession regarding the right, and who is allowed to do it if he is justified.

names.ar: بَابُ: كَيْفَ يَحْلِفُ أَهْلُ الذِّمَّةِ وَالْمُسْتَأْمَنُونَ
names.en: How do the people of the dhimmah and the protected ones swear?

names.ar: بَابُ: يَحْلِفُ الْمُدَّعَى عَلَيْهِ فِي حَقِّ نَفْسِهِ عَلَى الْبَتِّ , وَفِيمَا غَابَ عَنْهُ عَلَى نَفْيِ الْعِلْمِ
names.en: The plaintiff swears on his own right to the judge, and on what he is absent from on the denial of knowledge.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي قَوْلِ اللهِ ﷻ: {وَأَتَيْنَاهُ الْحِكْمَةَ وَفَصْلَ الْخِطَابِ} وَمَنْ رَضِيَ بِحُكْمِ اللهِ ﷻ فِي ذَلِكَ
names.en: What Allah says: "And We gave him wisdom and decisive speech." And whoever is satisfied with Allah's judgment regarding that.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ بَدَأَ فَحَلَفَ عِنْدَ الْحَاكِمِ أَعَادَ الْحَاكِمُ عَلَيْهِ الْيَمِينَ حَتَّى تَكُونَ يَمِينُهُ بَعْدَ خُرُوجِ الْحُكْمِ بِهَا
names.en: Whoever initiated and swore an oath in front of the ruler, the ruler will repeat the oath to him until his right hand is positioned after the ruling.

names.ar:
بَابُ: الْيَمِينُ فِي الطَّلَاقِ وَالْعَتَاقِ وَغَيْرِهِمَا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: وَإِذَا أَحْلَفَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ رُكَانَةَ فِي الطَّلَاقِ فَهَذَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى أَنَّ الْيَمِينَ فِي الطَّلَاقِ كَمَا هِيَ فِي غَيْرِهِ
names.en: The Right to Divorce and Manumission, and Others.

names.ar: بَابُ: الْمُدَّعِي يُسْتَمْهَلُ لَيَأْتِيَ بِبَيِّنَةٍ
names.en: The plaintiff is urged to present evidence.

names.ar:
بَابُ الْبَيِّنَةُ الْعَادِلَةُ أَحَقُّ مِنَ الْيَمِينِ الْفَاجِرَةِ
رُوِيَ ذَلِكَ , عَنْ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ وَشُرَيْحٍ الْقَاضِي رَحِمَهُ اللهُ
names.en:
The fair evidence is more deserving than the wicked right.
It was narrated, from Umar ibn Al Khattab and Shurayh Al Qadi, may Allah have mercy on them.

names.ar: بَابُ: النُّكُولُ , وَرَدُّ الْيَمِينِ
names.en: Translation: "Ankle, right turn.

names.ar:
جُمَّاعُ أَبْوَابِ مَنْ تَجُوزُ شَهَادَتُهُ , وَمَنْ لَا تَجُوزُ مِنَ الْأَحْرَارِ الْبَالِغِينَ الْعَاقِلِينَ الْمُسْلِمِينَ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " لَيْسَ أَحَدٌ مِنَ النَّاسِ نَعْلَمُهُ , أَنْ لَا يَكُونَ قَلِيلًا , يَمْحَضُ الطَّاعَةَ وَالْمُرُوءَةَ , حَتَّى لَا يَخْلِطَهَا بِمَعْصِيَةٍ وَلَا تَرَكَ الْمُرُوءَةَ , وَلَا يَمْحَضُ الْمَعْصِيَةَ وَتَرْكَ الْمُرُوءَةِ حَتَّى لَا يَخْلِطَهَا بِشَيْءٍ مِنَ الطَّاعَةِ وَالْمُرُوءَةِ " قَالَ الشَّيْخُ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " هُوَ كَمَا قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ "
names.en:
Group of People Whose Testimony is Valid, and Those Whose Testimony is Not Valid Among Free Adult Rational Muslims.
Imam Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "None of the people we know should be someone who lacks modesty and integrity, to the point where they mix it with disobedience and abandon modesty, nor should they lack disobedience and abandon modesty to the point where they mix it with anything from obedience and modesty." The Scholar (may Allah have mercy on him) said: "He is just as Imam Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him) said.

names.ar: بَابُ: بَيَانُ مَكَارِمِ الْأَخْلَاقِ وَمَعَالِيهَا
names.en: Virtues of Good Character and its Excellences

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ كَانَ مُنْكَشِفَ الْكَذِبِ مُظْهِرَهُ غَيْرَ مُسْتَتِرٍ بِهِ , لَمْ تَجُزْ شَهَادَتُهُ
names.en: The testimony of someone who is not concealed in their lies is not valid

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ جُرِّبَ بِشَهَادَةِ زُورٍ لَمْ تُقْبَلْ شَهَادَتُهُ
names.en: Whoever is tested with a false testimony that his testimony was not accepted

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ يُظَنُّ بِهِ الْكَذِبُ , وَلَهُ مَخْرَجٌ مِنْهُ , لَمْ يَلْزَمُهُ اسْمُ كَذَّابٍ
names.en: Who is believed in to be a liar, and has a way out of it, does not need the name of a liar

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ وَعَدَ غَيْرَهُ شَيْئًا , وَمِنْ نِيَّتِهِ أَنْ يَفِيَ بِهِ , ثُمَّ وَفَى بِهِ , أَوْ لَمْ يَفِ بِهِ لِعُذْرٍ , وَمَنْ وَعَدَ وَمِنْ نِيَّتِهِ أَنْ لَا يَفِيَ بِهِ
names.en: Whoever promises someone else something and intends to fulfill it, and then fulfills it, or does not fulfill it for a valid excuse, and whoever promises someone else and intends not to fulfill it.

names.ar: بَابُ: الْمَعَارِيضُ فِيهَا مَنْدُوحَةٌ عَنِ الْكَذِبِ
names.en: Diseases with immunity against lies

names.ar: بَابُ: مَنْ سَمَّى الْمَرْأَةَ قَارُورَةً , وَالْفَرَسَ بَحْرًا عَلَى طَرِيقِ التَّشْبِيهِ , أَوْ سَمَّى الْأَعْمَى بَصِيرًا عَلَى طَرِيقِ التَّفَاؤُلِ
names.en: Who named the woman a bottle, and the horse a sea by way of comparison, or named the blind person insightful, by way of optimism?

names.ar: بَابُ: لَا تُقْبَلُ شَهَادَةُ خَائِنٍ وَلَا خَائِنَةٍ وَلَا ذِي غِمْرٍ عَلَى أَخِيهِ وَلَا ظَنِينٍ وَلَا خَصْمٍ
names.en: The heading translates to: "Neither the testimony of a traitor, nor that of a traitress, nor the deceitful brotherhood, nor suspicion, nor opposition is accepted.

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَنْ قَالَ: لَا تَجُوزُ شَهَادَةُ الْوَالِدِ لِوَلَدِهِ , وَالْوَلَدِ لِوَالِدَيْهِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " لِأَنَّهُ مِنْ آبَائِهِ , فَإِنَّمَا يَشْهَدُ لِشَيْءٍ هُوَ مِنْهُ , وَإِنَّ بَنِيهِ هُمْ مِنْهُ , فَكَأَنَّمَا شَهِدَ لِبَعْضِهِ "
names.en:
Who said: "The testimony of a parent is not valid for their child, and the testimony of a child is not valid for their parents."
Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "Because he is from his parents, one can only testify for something that is separate from him, and indeed his children are from him, so it is as if he is testifying for a part of himself.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي شَهَادَةِ الْأَخِ لِأَخِيهِ
names.en: What the witness stated about his brother

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا تُرَدُّ بِهِ شَهَادَةُ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ
قَالَ بَعْضُ أَصْحَابِنَا: هُوَ إِظْهَارُ منْ أَظْهَرَ مِنْهُمْ نَفْيَ صِفَاتِ اللهِ تَعَالَى الَّتِي قَدْ وَرَدَ الْكِتَابُ بِهَا , وَدَلَّتِ السُّنَّةُ الْمُسْتَفِيضَةُ مَعَ إِجْمَاعِ سَلَفِ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ عَلَى إِثْبَاتِهَا , نَحْوَ الْكَلَامِ وَالْقُدْرَةِ وَالْعِلْمِ وَالْمَشِيئَةِ , وَأَنَّ الْأَفْعَالَ كُلَّهَا لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى مَخْلُوقَةٌ , فَقَدْ جَاءَتِ الْأَخْبَارُ بِتَكْفِيرِ مُنْكِرِيهَا , وَتَبَرَّأَ سَلَفُ هَذِهِ الْأُمَّةِ مِنْ مَذْهَبِ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ فِيهَا
names.en: What is rejected by the testimony of the people of desires? Some of our companions said: It is the manifestation of those who deny the attributes of Allah mentioned in the Book and proven by the extensive Sunnah, along with the consensus of the early generations of this ummah, regarding their affirmation, such as speech, power, knowledge, and will. And it is affirmed that all actions are created by Allah. The reports came condemning those who deny these beliefs, and the early generations of this ummah dissociated themselves from the beliefs of the people of desires in this matter.

names.ar:
بَابُ: الرَّجُلُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْفِقْهِ يُسْأَلُ عَنِ الرَّجُلِ مِنْ أَهْلِ الْحَدِيثِ فَيَقُولُ: كُفُّوا عَنْ حَدِيثِهِ , لِأَنَّهُ يَغْلِطُ أَوْ يُحَدِّثُ بِمَا لَمْ يَسْمَعْ , أَوْ أَنَّهُ لَا يُبْصِرُ الْفُتْيَا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " لَيْسَ هَذَا بِعَدَاوَةٍ وَلَا غِيبَةٍ , إِذَا كَانَ يَقُولُهُ لِمَنْ يَخَافُ أَنْ يَتَّبِعَهُ فَيُخْطِئَ بِاتِّبَاعِهِ , وَهَذَا مِنْ مَعَانِي الشَّهَادَاتِ
names.en: The man of jurisprudence is asked about the man of hadith, and he says: refrain from his hadith, because he makes mistakes or narrates things he hasn't heard, or he lacks insight in issuing religious rulings. Al-Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "This is not enmity or slander, when he says it to someone who fears following him and making a mistake by his following. This is one of the meanings of testimony.

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا تَجُوزُ بِهِ شَهَادَةُ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " كُلُّ مَنْ تَأَوَّلَ فَأَتَى شَيْئًا مُسْتَحِلًّا كَانَ فِيهِ حَدٌّ أَوْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَمْ تُرَدَّ شَهَادَتُهُ بِذَلِكَ , أَلَا تَرَى أَنَّ مِمَّنْ حُمِلَ عَنْهُ الدِّينُ , وَنُصِبَ عَلَمًا فِي الْبُلْدَانِ مَنْ قَدِ اسْتَحَلَّ الْمُتْعَةَ , وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ يَسْتَحِلُّ الدِّينَارَ بِعَشَرَةِ دَنَانِيرَ , يَدًا بِيَدٍ , وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ قَدْ تَأَوَّلَ فَاسْتَحَلَّ سَفْكَ الدِّمَاءِ , وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ تَأَوَّلَ فَشَرِبَ كُلَّ مُسْكِرٍ غَيْرَ الْخَمْرِ , وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَحَلَّ إِتْيَانَ النِّسَاءِ فِي أَدْبَارِهِنَّ , وَمِنْهُمْ مَنْ أَحَلَّ بُيُوعًا مُحَرَّمَةً عِنْدَ غَيْرِهِ , فَإِذَا كَانَ هَؤُلَاءِ - مَعَ مَا وَصَفْتُ - أَهْلَ ثِقَةٍ فِي دِينِهِمْ , وَقَنَاعَةٍ عِنْدَ مَنْ عَرَفَهُمْ , وَقَدْ تُرِكَ عَلَيْهِ مَا تَأَوَّلُوا فَأَخْطَئُوا فِيهِ , وَلَمْ يَخْرُجُوا بِعَظِيمِ الْخَطَأِ إِذَا كَانَ مِنْهُمْ عَلَى وَجْهِ الِاسْتِحْلَالِ كَانَ جَمِيعُ أَهْلِ الْأَهْوَاءِ فِي هَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ "
names.en: What is permissible as the testimony of people of desires?

names.ar:
بَابُ: الِاخْتِلَافُ فِي اللَّعِبِ بِالشِّطْرَنْجِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: وَإِذَا كَانُوا هَكَذَا - يَعْنِي: أَهْلَ الْأَهْوَاءِ , فَاللَّاعِبُ بِالشِّطْرَنْجِ وَإِنْ كَرِهْنَا لَهُ , وَبِالْحَمَامِ , وَإِنْ كَرِهْنَا لَهُ , أَخَفُّ حَالًا مِنْ هَؤُلَاءِ بِمَا لَا يُحْصَى وَلَا يُقَدَّرُ. وَإِنَّمَا قَالَ ذَلِكَ لِمَا فِيهِ أَيْضًا مِنَ اخْتِلَافِ الْعُلَمَاءِ.
names.en:
The Disagreement in Playing Chess
Al-Shafi'i said: And if they are like this - meaning the people of desires, then the chess player, even if we dislike him, and the bath, even if we dislike it, is easier in condition than those with countless and immeasurable things. And he only said that because of the disagreement among the scholars.

names.ar: بَابُ: كَرَاهِيَةُ اللَّعِبِ بِالْحَمَامِ
names.en: The dislike of playing with pigeons

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَا يَدُلُّ عَلَى رَدِّ شَهَادَةِ مَنْ قَامَرَ بِالْحَمَامِ أَوْ بِالشِّطْرَنْجِ, أَوْ بِغَيْرِهِمَا
قَالَ اللهُ تَعَالَى: {إِنَّمَا الْخَمْرُ وَالْمَيْسِرُ} [المائدة: 90] الْآيَةَ
names.en: What indicates the invalidity of the testimony of someone who participated in gambling, playing chess, or any similar activity? Allah Almighty said: "Indeed, intoxicants, gambling," [Quran 5:90]

names.ar:
بَابُ: شَهَادَةُ أَهْلِ الْأَشْرِبَةِ
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " مَنْ شَرِبَ مِنَ الْخَمْرِ شَيْئًا وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُهَا خَمْرًا رُدَّتْ شَهَادَتُهُ , لِأَنَّ تَحْرِيمَهَا نَصٌّ فِي كِتَابِ اللهِ , سَكِرَ أَوْ لَمْ يَسْكَرْ , وَقَالَ فِيمَا سِوَاهَا مِنَ الْأَشْرِبَةِ الَّتِي يُسْكِرُ كَثِيرُهَا: فَهُوَ عِنْدَنَا مُخْطِئٌ بِشُرْبِهِ , آثِمٌ بِهِ , وَلَا تُرَدُّ بِهِ شَهَادَتُهُ " , يَعْنِي لِمَا فِيهِ مِنَ الْخِلَافِ , قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ: " مَا لَمْ يَسْكَرْ مِنْهُ , فَإِذَا سَكِرَ مِنْهُ فَشَهَادَتُهُ مَرْدُودَةٌ مِنْ قِبَلِ أَنَّ السُّكْرَ مُحَرَّمٌ عِنْدَ جَمِيعِ أَهْلِ الْإِسْلَامِ "
names.en: The Testimony of Drinkers

names.ar: بَابُ: كَرَاهِيَةُ اللَّعِبِ بِالنَّرْدِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ كَرَاهِيَةِ اللَّعِبِ بِالشَّيْءِ مِنَ الْمَلَاهِي لِثُبُوتِ الْخَبَرِ فِيهِ وَكَثْرَتِهِ
names.en: The dislike of playing with dice more than the dislike of playing with toys due to the certainty and abundance of news in it.

names.ar:
بَابُ: مَنْ كَرِهَ كُلَّ مَا لَعِبَ النَّاسُ بِهِ مِنَ الْحَزَّةِ , وَهِيَ قِطْعَةُ خَشَبٍ يَكُونُ فِيهَا حُفَرٌ يَلْعَبُونَ بِهَا وَالْقِرْقِ وَنَحْوِهَا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " لِأَنَّ اللَّعِبَ لَيْسَ مِنْ صَنْعَةِ أَهْلِ الدِّينِ وَلَا الْمُرُوءَةِ "
names.en:
Whoever dislikes everything that people play with from haya, which is a piece of wood with engraved lines that they play with, as well as the qirqi and similar games.

Imam Shafi'i, may Allah have mercy on him, said: "Because playing is not the trade of people of religion or honor.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا لَا يُنْهَى عَنْهُ مِنَ اللَّعِبِ
names.en: What is not prohibited from playing

names.ar:
بَابُ: يَنْبَغِي لِلْمَرْءِ أَنْ لَا يَبْلُغَ مِنْهُ وَلَا مِنْ غَيْرِهِ مِنْ تِلَاوَةِ الْقُرْآنِ , وَلَا صَلَاةِ نَافِلَةٍ , وَلَا نَظَرٍ فِي عِلْمٍ مَا يَشْغَلُهُ عَنِ الصَّلَاةِ حَتَّى يَخْرُجَ وَقْتُهَا
قَالَ الشَّافِعِيُّ رَحِمَهُ اللهُ: " لِأَنَّ الْمَكْتُوبَةَ أَوْجَبُ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ جَمِيعِ النَّوَافِلِ "
names.en: It is necessary for a person to not exceed in reciting the Quran, performing voluntary prayers, or engaging in any knowledge that distracts them from prayer until its prescribed time comes. According to Imam Shafi'i (may Allah have mercy on him), this duty is obligatory for him over all voluntary acts.

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي اللَّعِبِ بِالْبَنَاتِ
names.en: What came in playing with the girls

names.ar: بَابُ: مَا جَاءَ فِي الْمَرَاجِيحِ
names.en: What is in the swings?

names.ar:
